d6df742c-4c41-41a7-b81f-a5b2cd314578/Eve.en: The moon hangs low, yet a lone lamp still flickers in the darkness...<NL><NL>In a restless dream, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> is seized by a sudden chill.<NL>Faint trails of blood snake across the ground,<NL>winding in from every direction before converging upon a cave strewn with uncanny black stones and crimson ash...
d6df742c-4c41-41a7-b81f-a5b2cd314578/Eve.cn: 月落星稀，孤灯未灭……<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />睡梦之中，只觉一阵恶寒袭来，<NL>抬眼望去，竟见地面浮现数十道淡淡血痕，<NL>自四面八方蜿蜒汇聚，向那遍布玄色怪石、满地殷红灰烬的洞窟流去……

d6df742c-4c41-41a7-b81f-a5b2cd314578/Opt.en: What are these trails...? Why do they all lead to the Blackstone Land...?
d6df742c-4c41-41a7-b81f-a5b2cd314578/Opt.cn: 这是何物……何以流向玄石之地……
d6df742c-4c41-41a7-b81f-a5b2cd314578/Opt.ru: Что это за тропы...? Почему все они ведут в Страну Блэкстоунов...?

d3ad7ddb-5772-40b0-899a-63edde9d8b4a/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> gazes upon the blood trails. <NL>A chill runs deep. Some nameless horror seems to lurk at their end. <NL>Yet before realizing it, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> feet have already begun to carry <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderObject/> forward...<NL><NL>The closer <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> draws, the more the mind begins to waver.<NL>Greed, hatred, and delusion surge forth unbidden; every earthly desire stirs within.<NL>Only by keeping a clear mind can <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> press on...
d3ad7ddb-5772-40b0-899a-63edde9d8b4a/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />凝望血痕，<NL>心下悚然，只觉其中伏藏着何种可怖之物，<NL>然而双脚却已不由自主，向那血痕缓步行去……<NL><NL>随着<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />缓步趋近，不知不觉间，<NL>贪嗔痴念，齐涌心头；七情六欲，纷至沓来，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />当下收摄心神，方能勉力近前……

d3ad7ddb-5772-40b0-899a-63edde9d8b4a/Opt.en: This blood flows toward the Blackstone Land, carrying a presence that unsettles the mind. Could it be "Xiangshu Demonic Blood"...?
d3ad7ddb-5772-40b0-899a-63edde9d8b4a/Opt.cn: 此血流向玄石之地，更能蛊惑心神，莫非乃是“相枢魔血”……
d3ad7ddb-5772-40b0-899a-63edde9d8b4a/Opt.ru: Эта кровь течет к Земле Блэкстоуна, неся с собой присутствие, которое выбивает из колеи разум. Может быть, это "Демоническая кровь Сяншу"...?

a4d67dc4-5997-45d3-b4dd-bc86959f061f/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> lowers their gaze.<NL>Only a faint trace of blood remains on the Fuyu Hilt.<NL>For a moment, reality and illusion blur beyond distinction...
a4d67dc4-5997-45d3-b4dd-bc86959f061f/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />垂首看去，<NL>但见「伏虞剑柄」之上，唯余一道淡淡血光，<NL>一时之间，竟不知适才所历，是真是幻……
a4d67dc4-5997-45d3-b4dd-bc86959f061f/Eve.ru: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> опускает взгляд.<NL>На Рукояти Фую остался лишь слабый след крови.<NL>На мгновение реальность и иллюзия стираются до неузнаваемости...

fb1b6115-3a99-451f-9088-abab81cede9c/Eve.en: As <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> passes through <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=CurBlock/>,<NL>an open courtyard gate comes into view ahead. Several burly men are carrying wooden chests inside,<NL>while others stand guard with weapons in hand before the entrance...<NL><NL>The place is none other than <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=CurBlock/>'s warehouse. Supplies are being counted and moved inside for safekeeping...
fb1b6115-3a99-451f-9088-abab81cede9c/Eve.cn: 这一日，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />途经<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=CurBlock/>，<NL>但见前方一处院门洞开，数名武夫打扮之人，正自搬运木箱入院，<NL>另有数人手持兵刃，凝神戒备，护卫院前……<NL><NL>原来此处乃是<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=CurBlock/>库房，众人正自清点物资，存入库房……

d8b5b8d8-b2eb-43e8-a59a-688200eebaf5/Eve.en: Just as <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> turns to leave,<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> stride suddenly faltered. A bone-deep chill washes over <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderObject/>,<NL>and a crimson veil seems to descend across <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> vision. The world around <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderObject/> warps and twists, and in an instant, everything changes...
d8b5b8d8-b2eb-43e8-a59a-688200eebaf5/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />正欲转身离去，<NL>脚下蓦地一滞，只觉一阵恶寒袭来，<NL>眼前竟似被一片血色笼罩，周遭的景致尽数扭曲，转眼之间，已是另一番模样……

40ef6e51-b3e6-4f63-8e33-567901f26f3c/Eve.en: A searing pain tears through <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s head. <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=UpperGenderSubject/> doubles over, clutching <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> ears,<NL>yet the voice only grows clearer, more insistent, as though rising from the depths of <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> own heart, whispering ceaselessly:<NL><NL> "I spent years building Taiwu Village into what it is today.<NL>They enjoy peace and prosperity without lifting a finger, surrounded by wealth beyond measure..."<NL>"A fine sword belongs in the hands of a hero. Gold and silver belong to the worthy. Yet these people do not even think to offer them up. Have they no sense of propriety?"<NL>"The wealth of the world exists to serve the world. Since all under Heaven belongs to Taiwu, what harm is there in taking a small share for myself?"<NL><NL>As the final whisper fades, a thought suddenly takes root in <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> mind...
40ef6e51-b3e6-4f63-8e33-567901f26f3c/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />但觉头痛欲裂，蹲身俯首，捂住双耳，<NL>然而那声音愈发清晰，愈发坚定，竟似自心底生出，喃喃不休：<NL><NL>“我数载经营，太吾村方有今日光景，<NL>他们坐享安稳，轻而易举，便是金山银山……”<NL>“宝剑当奉英雄，金银当归义士，这些人竟不亲手献上，岂非不知礼数？”<NL>“取天下之财，以供天下之费，天下资财尽归太吾所有，今日我取用一二，又有何不可！”<NL><NL>心中话音方落，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />蓦地生出一念……

40ef6e51-b3e6-4f63-8e33-567901f26f3c/Opt.en: (Take from the world to give to the world. Nothing could be more right!)
40ef6e51-b3e6-4f63-8e33-567901f26f3c/Opt.cn: （四海之财，取以济世，理所应当！）
40ef6e51-b3e6-4f63-8e33-567901f26f3c/Opt.ru: (Берите у мира, чтобы отдавать миру. Ничто не может быть более правильным!)

40ef6e51-b3e6-4f63-8e33-567901f26f3c/Opt.en: (Wealth should be gained by honest means. Such thoughts must not be indulged...)
40ef6e51-b3e6-4f63-8e33-567901f26f3c/Opt.cn: （君子爱财，取之有道，不可妄为……）
40ef6e51-b3e6-4f63-8e33-567901f26f3c/Opt.ru: (Богатство должно быть приобретено честным путем. Таким мыслям нельзя потакать...)

e5a1fa1b-01bf-4e52-8f54-537a9327ac33/Eve.en: The whisper vanishes as suddenly as it came, and the world returns to normal.<NL>The burly men are still hauling wooden chests into the warehouse, while the others remain at their posts, weapons in hand.<NL>Everything <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> has just seen and heard seems no more than an illusion...<NL><NL>And yet, the thought lingers, churning endlessly in <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s mind...
e5a1fa1b-01bf-4e52-8f54-537a9327ac33/Eve.cn: 低语之声倏然散去，四下一如寻常，<NL>但见那几名武人尚在搬运木箱，另几人仍是手持兵刃，严守库房，<NL>仿佛适才<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />所见所闻，皆是南柯一梦……<NL><NL>然而<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />心中一念，已是盘旋不去，翻涌难休……

2a44dd70-fdfd-48aa-8a6a-e33ca48018db/Eve.en: As <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> passes through <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=CurBlock/>,<NL>the aroma of freshly brewed tea drifts through the air, soothing and inviting.<NL><NL>A small tea stall stands by the roadside, the shopkeeper tending a kettle over the fire.<NL>After days of travel, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> is weary and parched, and makes <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> way toward the stall, hoping to rest for a while...
2a44dd70-fdfd-48aa-8a6a-e33ca48018db/Eve.cn: 这一日，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />途经<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=CurBlock/>，<NL>忽闻茶香袅袅，沁人心脾，<NL><NL>但见路旁设着一处茶摊，摊主正自烹茶添水，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />连日奔波，口干舌燥，便欲在此歇息片刻，饮茶解乏……

baa89c62-a5b9-4ece-8c7e-6b89ce824750/Eve.en: The whisper vanishes as suddenly as it came, and the world returns to normal.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> steadies <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> thoughts and turns to leave, only to hear someone calling from behind...
baa89c62-a5b9-4ece-8c7e-6b89ce824750/Eve.cn: 低语之声倏然散去，四下一如寻常，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />心神稍定，正欲转身离去，忽听得身后传来一声呼唤……
baa89c62-a5b9-4ece-8c7e-6b89ce824750/Eve.ru: Шепот исчезает так же внезапно, как и появился, и мир возвращается в нормальное русло.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> стабилизирует <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> размышляет и поворачивается, чтобы уйти, только чтобы услышать, как кто-то зовет сзади...

baa89c62-a5b9-4ece-8c7e-6b89ce824750/Opt.en: (Look over to where the voice came from...)

1b898eea-38e2-434f-b1f0-d577b1e04ecf/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> looks back toward the voice.<NL>A man is striding over with several burly men carrying wooden chests.<NL>Upon reaching <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />, he immediately bows low:<NL><NL>"Please forgive my delay. <NL>Word of the Successor of Taiwu's arrival only just reached me, so I came as quickly as I could.<NL>I've long heard of your exploits. Meeting you today, I see the stories were no exaggeration!"
1b898eea-38e2-434f-b1f0-d577b1e04ecf/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />循声望去，<NL>只见一人领着数名怀抱木箱的武夫，阔步而来，<NL>那人行至<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />近前，一揖到地：<NL><NL>“见谅，见谅……<NL>在下方才闻得太吾传人大驾光临，是以迟来拜见，<NL>早闻太吾传人英名，今日得见，果然名不虚传！”

1b898eea-38e2-434f-b1f0-d577b1e04ecf/Opt.en: Please don't trouble yourself. I'm only passing through.
1b898eea-38e2-434f-b1f0-d577b1e04ecf/Opt.cn: 阁下不必客气，在下只是途经此处，本也无意叨扰……
1b898eea-38e2-434f-b1f0-d577b1e04ecf/Opt.ru: Пожалуйста, не утруждайте себя. Я всего лишь проезжаю мимо.

583affad-e3b7-45c7-ad83-05160f0c4a23/Eve.en: "Your presence is no trouble at all! In an age where demons and evil spirits run rampant,<NL>without your protection, we would have already fallen to their hands..."
583affad-e3b7-45c7-ad83-05160f0c4a23/Eve.cn: “太吾传人这是哪里话！而今妖魔横行，鬼怪当道，<NL>若非太吾传人舍身护佑，我等恐怕早已死于妖邪之手……”
583affad-e3b7-45c7-ad83-05160f0c4a23/Eve.ru: - Ваше присутствие вовсе не доставляет мне хлопот! В эпоху, когда демоны и злые Духи свирепствуют,<NL>без вашей защиты мы бы уже попали в их руки..."

dd58852a-42d3-4cca-9f4d-a737534f21f2/Eve.en: Unable to turn down such hospitality, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> accepts the supplies with thanks.<NL>After speaking with <CharacterOrActor key=Oldman str=Name/> a while longer, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> finally takes <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> leave...
dd58852a-42d3-4cca-9f4d-a737534f21f2/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />盛情难却，只得收下物资，拱手道谢，<NL>而后又与<CharacterOrActor key=Oldman str=Name/>闲叙片刻，方才拱手告辞……

f1238e30-d341-4283-abd0-f789c9e65448/Eve.en: After looting the warehouse,<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> finds no peace. Restless heat churns within, thoughts in constant turmoil.<NL><NL>A sudden chill surges from the Fuyu Hilt in <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> grasp, so cold it is nearly impossible to hold.<NL>Lowering <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> gaze, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> sees dark flames roiling across the hilt, swaying toward the distance as if beckoning <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderObject/> onward...
f1238e30-d341-4283-abd0-f789c9e65448/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />掠夺库房过后，<NL>不知何故，但觉心头燥热难安，百念交攻，<NL><NL>正自此神迷意夺之际，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />忽感手中「伏虞剑柄」阴寒刺骨，几难握持，<NL>当即垂首看去，竟见剑柄之上黑焰翻涌，飘摇向前，似为指引……

1d47daa9-f946-4de8-92c3-6c1e1b5f7dda/Eve.en: Alarmed, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> follows its direction.<NL>Ahead lies a land awash in blood. Countless trails of blood wind across the earth, converging into what seems a vast sea of crimson.<NL>It is identical to the "Xiangshu Demonic Blood" seen in the dream...
1d47daa9-f946-4de8-92c3-6c1e1b5f7dda/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />心头一凛，循之望去，<NL>但见前方赤血盈野，无数血痕蜿蜒汇聚，化作一片血海也似，<NL>竟与先前梦中所见“相枢魔血”一般无二……
1d47daa9-f946-4de8-92c3-6c1e1b5f7dda/Eve.ru: Встревоженный, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> следует его направлению.<NL>Впереди лежит земля, залитая кровью. Бесчисленные кровавые следы тянутся по земле, сходясь в то, что кажется бескрайним багровым морем.<NL>Это идентично "Демонической крови Сяншу", увиденной во сне...

1d47daa9-f946-4de8-92c3-6c1e1b5f7dda/Opt.en: (Head to where the demonic blood lies and investigate...)
1d47daa9-f946-4de8-92c3-6c1e1b5f7dda/Opt.cn: （前往魔血所在之处，一探究竟……）
1d47daa9-f946-4de8-92c3-6c1e1b5f7dda/Opt.ru: (Отправляйтесь туда, где находится демоническая кровь, и исследуйте...)

e2a35391-2134-4b4c-8115-7d6d428c079c/Eve.en: No sooner has <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> taken a seat than the shopkeeper comes forward, <NL>swiftly setting down a pottery cup and pouring a bowl of herbal tea.<NL>As <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> thanks him and raises the cup, faint whispers drift in from nearby.<NL> Turning toward the sound, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> sees two nearby patrons chatting over tea. <NL><NL>From time to time, the words "Taiwu" and "Xiangshu" slip into <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> ears...
e2a35391-2134-4b4c-8115-7d6d428c079c/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />甫一落座，摊主便即迎上前来，<NL>麻利地摆上粗瓷茶碗，提壶斟了一碗凉茶，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />道谢过后，正欲举碗饮茶，忽闻耳畔传来窃窃私语之声，<NL>循声望去，原是邻座两人正自饮茶闲聊，<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />不时只听得“太吾”“相枢”等字眼传入耳中……

d6d5a04a-fd5e-4093-af3b-c1c560e2b768/Eve.en: A searing pain tears through <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s head. <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=UpperGenderSubject/> doubles over, clutching <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> ears,<NL>yet the voice only grows clearer, more insistent, as though rising from the depths of <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> own heart, whispering ceaselessly:<NL><NL> "They live in peace under my protection, yet forget all I have done..."<NL>"Amid blood and steel, before demons and heretics... Was all that blood truly shed in vain?"<NL>"Such ungrateful, hypocritical wretches would be intolerable if left unpunished!"<NL><NL>As the final whisper fades, a thought suddenly takes root in <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> mind...
d6d5a04a-fd5e-4093-af3b-c1c560e2b768/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />但觉头痛欲裂，蹲身俯首，捂住双耳，<NL>然而那声音愈发清晰，愈发坚定，竟似自心底生出，喃喃不休：<NL><NL>“这些人安享太平，受我庇护，却从未念我半分辛劳……”<NL>“刀光剑影之中，邪魔外道之前，当真热血空流？”<NL>“这般忘恩负义、口是心非之徒，若不惩戒，岂非天理难容！”<NL><NL>心中话音方落，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />蓦地生出一念……

d6d5a04a-fd5e-4093-af3b-c1c560e2b768/Opt.en: (The masses are blind and ignorant. Without punishment, how can they be warned and guided toward righteousness?)
d6d5a04a-fd5e-4093-af3b-c1c560e2b768/Opt.cn: （众生蒙昧，若不惩戒，何以警示愚顽，匡正人心！）
d6d5a04a-fd5e-4093-af3b-c1c560e2b768/Opt.ru: (Массы слепы и невежественны. Без наказания как они могут быть предупреждены и направлены к праведности?)

d6d5a04a-fd5e-4093-af3b-c1c560e2b768/Opt.en: (I have done nothing to be ashamed of before justice itself. Such rumors are beneath my concern.)
d6d5a04a-fd5e-4093-af3b-c1c560e2b768/Opt.cn: （我之所为，不愧天地，何须理会，此间蜚语流言……）
d6d5a04a-fd5e-4093-af3b-c1c560e2b768/Opt.ru: (Я не сделал ничего такого, чего стоило бы стыдиться перед самим правосудием. Подобные слухи меня не касаются.)

6f37e260-0198-4a75-918c-4feb11a98b3b/Eve.en: The whisper vanishes as suddenly as it came, and the world returns to normal.<NL>Noticing <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s gaze, the two men immediately smile and bow, with perfect courtesy.<NL>As if all that had just been seen and heard were no more than an illusion...<NL><NL>And yet, the thought lingers, churning endlessly in <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s mind...
6f37e260-0198-4a75-918c-4feb11a98b3b/Eve.cn: 低语之声倏然散去，四下一如寻常，<NL>那二人察觉<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />视线，便即含笑欠身，礼数周全，神情甚是恭敬，<NL>仿佛适才所见所闻，皆是南柯一梦……<NL><NL>然而<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />心中之念，已是盘旋不去，翻涌难休……

49753b44-6a2e-4612-a7a0-8ba3e8450d51/Eve.en: The whisper vanishes as suddenly as it came, and the world returns to normal.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> gathers <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> thoughts, and drains the tea in a single motion.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> then calls the shopkeeper over, preparing to settle the bill and leave...
49753b44-6a2e-4612-a7a0-8ba3e8450d51/Eve.cn: 低语之声倏然散去，四下一如寻常，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />心神稍定，端起案上清茶，一饮而尽，<NL>旋即唤来摊主，欲要结账离去……

5c41282a-4433-454b-8f9a-6f1de1468ecd/Eve.en: The shopkeeper quickly pushes the money back and waves their hands in panic. <NL>"Someone has already paid for your tea.<NL>How could I accept payment twice?"
5c41282a-4433-454b-8f9a-6f1de1468ecd/Eve.cn: 摊主见状，登时奉还银钱，急得连连摆手：<NL>“哎呀，这可使不得，方才已有人替阁下付过茶钱，<NL>老头子怎敢再收您第二份？”
5c41282a-4433-454b-8f9a-6f1de1468ecd/Eve.ru: Владелец магазина быстро засовывает деньги обратно и в панике машет руками. <NL>- Кто-то уже заплатил за ваш чай.<NL>Как я мог принять платеж дважды?"

5c41282a-4433-454b-8f9a-6f1de1468ecd/Opt.en: I know no one here. Who could have paid for my tea?
5c41282a-4433-454b-8f9a-6f1de1468ecd/Opt.cn: 我在此处并无相识之人，却不知何人为我结清茶钱？
5c41282a-4433-454b-8f9a-6f1de1468ecd/Opt.ru: Я здесь никого не знаю. Кто мог заплатить за мой чай?

9512f8b1-dcdc-4af1-9354-c4d4414fa94c/Eve.en: "I cannot recall the names of those two guests...<NL>I only know they were seated right beside you earlier.<NL>They spoke of you as a renowned hero and wished to make your acquaintance over tea in place of wine.<NL>Not wishing to intrude, they paid for your tea before leaving, hoping it might offer you some respite after your journey..."
9512f8b1-dcdc-4af1-9354-c4d4414fa94c/Eve.cn: “老头子也记不得那二位贵客的名姓……<NL>只晓得……他们适才便坐在阁下旁边，<NL>他们只说阁下乃是当世英雄豪杰，甚是敬佩，本想以茶代酒，与阁下结识一番，<NL>却又不敢冒昧，是以临去之时，便替阁下买下些许清茶，愿能洗尽阁下一身风尘……”

9512f8b1-dcdc-4af1-9354-c4d4414fa94c/Opt.en: (So they meant no reproach or ill will...)
9512f8b1-dcdc-4af1-9354-c4d4414fa94c/Opt.cn: （原来那二人所言……并非怨怼苛责……）
9512f8b1-dcdc-4af1-9354-c4d4414fa94c/Opt.ru: (Значит, они не имели в виду ни упрека, ни недоброжелательства...)

e74b295c-9ba5-4235-aa4f-bfd9127629a0/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> murmurs, thinking back on recent events,<NL>their emotions in turmoil and their mind unable to find peace...
e74b295c-9ba5-4235-aa4f-bfd9127629a0/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />低声喃喃，思及此前所历种种，<NL>只觉近来七情萦怀，六欲缠身，纷扰难休……
e74b295c-9ba5-4235-aa4f-bfd9127629a0/Eve.ru: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> бормочет, вспоминая недавние события,<NL>их эмоции в смятении, а разум не в состоянии обрести покой...

e74b295c-9ba5-4235-aa4f-bfd9127629a0/Opt.en: (Steady the mind and act with caution...)
e74b295c-9ba5-4235-aa4f-bfd9127629a0/Opt.cn: （今后还当静心凝神，谨慎行事……）

9d06a849-184e-4c3c-ae28-7fd4a1a29fc5/Eve.en: After punishing them,<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> finds no peace. Restless heat churns within, thoughts in constant turmoil.<NL><NL>A sudden chill surges from the Fuyu Hilt in <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> grasp, so cold it is nearly impossible to hold.<NL>Lowering <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> gaze, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> sees dark flames roiling across the hilt, swaying toward the distance as if beckoning <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderObject/> onward...
9d06a849-184e-4c3c-ae28-7fd4a1a29fc5/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />惩戒他人过后，<NL>不知何故，但觉心头燥热难安，百念交攻，<NL><NL>正自此神迷意夺之际，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />忽感手中「伏虞剑柄」阴寒刺骨，几难握持，<NL>当即垂首看去，竟见剑柄之上黑焰翻涌，飘摇向前，似为指引……

eff97a48-bcc6-4d75-8805-3ccfd936fda7/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> passes through <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=CurBlock/>.<NL>Suddenly, bursts of laughter drift through the air, clear and light.<NL><NL>By the stream and among the woods, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> finds several young men and women gathered,<NL>some composing verse together, others spreading paper and grinding ink, a scene of carefree joy...
eff97a48-bcc6-4d75-8805-3ccfd936fda7/Eve.cn: 这一日，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />途经<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=CurBlock/>，<NL>忽闻阵阵笑语欢声，清脆悦耳，<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />抬眼望去，只见正有数名少年少女流连溪畔林间，<NL>或吟诗联句，或铺纸研墨，一副其乐融融景象……

d7aa7adb-1c62-47f8-bbea-5239c27d5404/Eve.en: Not wishing to disturb them, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> turns to leave,<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> stride suddenly faltering. A bone-deep chill washes over <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderObject/>,<NL>and a crimson veil seems to descend across <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> vision. The world around <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderObject/> warps and twists, and in an instant, everything changes...
d7aa7adb-1c62-47f8-bbea-5239c27d5404/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />不欲搅扰众人，便要转身离去，<NL>谁知脚下蓦地一滞，只觉一阵恶寒袭来，<NL>眼前竟似被一片血色笼罩，周遭的景致尽数扭曲，转眼之间，已是另一番模样……

f65732de-ba72-408b-b308-2d108dece7de/Eve.en: A searing pain tears through <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />’s head. <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=UpperGenderSubject/> doubles over, clutching <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> ears,<NL>yet the voice only grows clearer, more insistent, as though rising from the depths of <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> own heart, whispering ceaselessly:<NL><NL> "What a perfect moment, with such beauty before me. Why not give in to desire and live in the present?"<NL>"A warm beauty by your side. Surely far better than a lonely lamp and a cold, empty bed."<NL>"I have traveled through wind and frost, guarding all under heaven. Should I not claim every beauty this world has to offer and live freely at last?"<NL><NL>As the final whisper fades, a thought suddenly takes root in <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> mind...
f65732de-ba72-408b-b308-2d108dece7de/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />但觉头痛欲裂，蹲身俯首，捂住双耳，<NL>然而那声音愈发清晰，愈发坚定，竟似自心底生出，喃喃不休：<NL><NL>“良辰好景，美色当前，正当纵情遂欲，及时行乐……”<NL>“娇花解语，暖榻相依，岂不胜过残灯孤影、寒衾独枕？”<NL>“我披星戴月，护佑苍生，合该揽尽世间好颜色，逍遥快活，方慰风尘！”<NL><NL>心中话音方落，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />蓦地生出一念……

f65732de-ba72-408b-b308-2d108dece7de/Opt.en: (Life is fleeting and ever-changing. What's wrong with enjoying a brief moment of happiness?)
f65732de-ba72-408b-b308-2d108dece7de/Opt.cn: （人生世间，万般无常，便是快活片刻，又有何妨？）
f65732de-ba72-408b-b308-2d108dece7de/Opt.ru: (Жизнь быстротечна и постоянно меняется. Что плохого в том, чтобы насладиться кратким мгновением счастья?)

f65732de-ba72-408b-b308-2d108dece7de/Opt.en: (Why pursue fleeting pleasure, when it is but a dream upon waking...)
f65732de-ba72-408b-b308-2d108dece7de/Opt.cn: （何必图求，片刻欢愉，终是黄粱一梦，梦醒成空……）
f65732de-ba72-408b-b308-2d108dece7de/Opt.ru: (Зачем гнаться за мимолетным удовольствием, когда это всего лишь сон после пробуждения...)

3b5861b7-5323-4723-ac7f-1ceef9ecdaf3/Eve.en: The whisper vanishes as suddenly as it came, and the world returns to normal.<NL>Sensing <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s gaze, the young men and women wave in invitation from afar, full of youthful innocence and liveliness.<NL>As if all that had just been seen and heard were no more than an illusion...<NL><NL>And yet, the thought lingers, churning endlessly in <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s mind...
3b5861b7-5323-4723-ac7f-1ceef9ecdaf3/Eve.cn: 低语之声倏然散去，四下一如寻常，<NL>少年少女们似察觉了<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />的视线，遥遥招手相邀，一派天真烂漫之态，<NL>仿佛适才所见所闻，皆是南柯一梦……<NL><NL>然而<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />心中之念，已是盘旋不去，翻涌难休……

61faf6d0-a670-4a3f-836d-42e0de6bd4c8/Eve.en: The whisper vanishes as suddenly as it came, and the world returns to normal.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> gathers <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> thoughts and is about to leave, when a young man and woman come up to <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderObject/>.<NL>The young woman smiles softly, offering two jars of wine:<NL><NL> "Did we disturb you?<NL>A few friends and I have formed a poetry society and gathered by the stream to drink and compose verse.<NL>If you do not mind, please accept this wine as an apology."
61faf6d0-a670-4a3f-836d-42e0de6bd4c8/Eve.cn: 低语之声倏然散去，四下一如寻常，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />心神稍定，正欲离去，一对少年少女忽而上前，<NL>那少女眉眼弯弯，捧出两坛美酒，笑语盈盈道：<NL><NL>“我等可是扰了阁下的清净？<NL>我与几位友人结了个诗社，今日约在此间溪畔，饮酒赋诗，<NL>若是阁下不嫌弃，还请收下这坛薄酒，权作我等赔礼。”

61faf6d0-a670-4a3f-836d-42e0de6bd4c8/Opt.en: You are too kind. It is I who have disturbed your enjoyment...
61faf6d0-a670-4a3f-836d-42e0de6bd4c8/Opt.cn: 阁下何必客气，倒是我叨扰了诸位雅兴……
61faf6d0-a670-4a3f-836d-42e0de6bd4c8/Opt.ru: Вы слишком добры. Это я помешал вашему наслаждению...

b74e0cee-0d79-4f3a-973b-cddfa2428d5a/Eve.en: "In these troubled times, with chaos spreading under Xiangshu's influence, how could we seek comfort for ourselves?<NL>We have no martial skill. Unlike the Successor of Taiwu, we are no warriors who can slay demons or protect the world.<NL>All we can do is gather with friends, express ourselves through writing,<NL>and do what little we can to help the poor with modest donations of coin and grain..."<NL><NL>Her brows knit faintly as she speaks, a hint of helplessness in her expression.
b74e0cee-0d79-4f3a-973b-cddfa2428d5a/Eve.cn: “而今相枢乱世，生灵涂炭，我等岂敢贪图闲逸？<NL>只是我等并无武艺傍身，不能如太吾传人那般，斩妖除魔、护佑苍生，<NL>唯有略尽绵薄之力，聚友结社，借笔墨传情，<NL>呼吁仁人志士捐赠钱粮，接济贫弱……”<NL><NL>那少女说及此处，蛾眉微蹙，神情颇是无奈……

b74e0cee-0d79-4f3a-973b-cddfa2428d5a/Opt.en: I see now. You all seek to serve the world through your words. Truly admirable...
b74e0cee-0d79-4f3a-973b-cddfa2428d5a/Opt.cn: 原来如此，诸位心怀苍生，以文济世，亦令人敬佩……
b74e0cee-0d79-4f3a-973b-cddfa2428d5a/Opt.ru: Теперь я понимаю. Вы все стремитесь служить миру своими словами. Поистине достойно восхищения...

782fe566-9bfc-4e5c-89a6-c60c113ad8d8/Eve.en: The young man suddenly slaps his forehead, as if struck by inspiration.<NL>He quickly presses the jars of wine into <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s arms, then cups <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> hands in farewell and takes <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> leave, pulling the young woman along with him.<NL><NL>"When we spoke of Successor of Taiwu, I thought of a few lines. I must write them down!" <NL>"In that case, let us make Successor of Taiwu the theme of our gathering..."<NL>"..."
782fe566-9bfc-4e5c-89a6-c60c113ad8d8/Eve.cn: 少年听闻此言，忽然一拍脑袋，似是想起了什么，<NL>忙将少女手中的两坛美酒塞进<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />怀中，<NL>随后向<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />拱手告辞，拉住身旁的少女，匆匆而去：<NL><NL>“方才咱们说到太吾传人，我忽然有了几句好词，得赶紧记下来！”<NL>“既是如此，咱们此次诗会，不妨便以太吾传人为题……”<NL>“……”

782fe566-9bfc-4e5c-89a6-c60c113ad8d8/Opt.en: (With a wry smile, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> accepts the wine...)
782fe566-9bfc-4e5c-89a6-c60c113ad8d8/Opt.ru: (С кривой улыбкой, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> принимает вино...)

e8aeea12-9c4f-484c-be3e-939ed1ba03f1/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> has no choice but to take it. At that moment, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> feels the Fuyu Hilt in hand shudder slightly.<NL>Looking down, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> sees a blood-red light flowing across the Fuyu Hilt, surging restlessly as if eager to break free from the sword.<NL>Yet within moments, it quietly recedes and returns to silence...
e8aeea12-9c4f-484c-be3e-939ed1ba03f1/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />无可奈何，只得收下美酒，<NL>便在这时，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />忽觉手中「伏虞剑柄」微微一颤，<NL>垂首看去，但见「伏虞剑柄」之上血光流转，翻涌不定，似欲破剑而出，<NL>然而未及片刻，便又悄然敛去，归于沉寂……

71221a46-347b-4ab3-b676-e733552cbd88/Eve.en: The moon stands high above the treetops, veiling the blossoms in soft shadow. <NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> sits alone here when, for reasons unknown,<NL>a restless heat suddenly stirs within <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderObject/>, giving rise to intoxicating visions.<NL>Soft murmurs seem to drift through <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> ears, while fleeting visions of earthly delights dance before <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> eyes.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> resolve wavers. <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> longs only to seek out the one <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> desires and share this moonlit night together...
71221a46-347b-4ab3-b676-e733552cbd88/Eve.cn: 月上梢头，花影朦胧，正是美景良辰，<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />独坐此间，不知何故，<NL>忽觉心头燥热难耐，竟而生出靡靡绮念，<NL>耳中似有软语呢喃，眼前恍现尘世欢娱，<NL>一时心神摇曳，难以自持，只欲寻一心悦之人，同寝花月，共度今宵……

71221a46-347b-4ab3-b676-e733552cbd88/Opt.en: (Indulge desires and seek out a beloved...)
(Steady the mind and resist the lure of desire...)

9566cfbb-70a2-45c0-b7b3-6855f4df0bd4/Eve.en: A thought arises in <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s mind, and all restraints vanish. <NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> only wishes to find someone <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> cherishes, to spend this night together...
9566cfbb-70a2-45c0-b7b3-6855f4df0bd4/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />心念一动，再无拘缚，<NL>只欲寻一心悦之人，同寝花月，共度今宵……
9566cfbb-70a2-45c0-b7b3-6855f4df0bd4/Eve.ru: Мысль возникает в <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />разум, и все ограничения исчезают. <NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> только хочет найти кого-нибудь <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> дорожит тем, что проведет эту ночь вместе...

b38ab968-0d95-43d1-9d47-a2723ec41d85/Eve.en: As <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> arrives at <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=CurBlock/>, <NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> suddenly feels the Fuyu Hilt trembling incessantly. <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> immediately tries to draw it out. <NL><NL><ArgBox key=TempText type=string/><NL>Immediately afterward, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> feels <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> mind becoming enchanted, and <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> hand involuntarily reaches toward the Fuyu Hilt...
b38ab968-0d95-43d1-9d47-a2723ec41d85/Eve.cn: 这一日，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />甫至<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=CurBlock/>，<NL>忽觉怀中「伏虞剑柄」颤动不止，当即探手取出，<NL><NL><ArgBox key=TempText type=string/><NL>紧接着，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />只觉心荡神迷，手已不由自主，向「伏虞剑柄」伸去……

b38ab968-0d95-43d1-9d47-a2723ec41d85/Opt.en: (Steady the mind and restrain the hand...)

068f0b67-ace8-426e-ad3f-abd08fc9d4b0/Eve.en: In an instant, the world before <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> shatters.<NL><NL>Light fades from the sun and moon. Mountains and rivers crumble into ruin.<NL>In a breath, all life withers away, the earth dissolving into barren wasteland,<NL>swallowed by endless blood ash and blackstone spanning heaven and earth.<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> looks around, but <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> can no longer tell<NL>whether this is the mortal world, or some abyss beyond it...
068f0b67-ace8-426e-ad3f-abd08fc9d4b0/Eve.cn: 刹那之间，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />眼前景色骤变——<NL><NL>天上日月隐没，地下山河崩竭，<NL>转眼草木摧折，顷刻桑田倾覆，<NL>尽化作无尽血灰、万里玄石，遍及天地，<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />举目四顾，一时也不知，<NL>此身所在乃是人间、亦或无间……

aa3b3213-2fec-4ba2-904f-4a6ba58b7c2d/Eve.en: Suddenly, <NL>at the edge of this abyss, blackstone fractures open and blood ash pours forth.<NL>A dark shadow rises from within. It grows, and grows still further, until it spans both heaven and earth.<NL>Its blood-red eyes open like the sun and the moon, casting their light upon all creation.<NL><NL>Yet it does not move. It stands there as if it had existed since the dawn of time.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> looks upon it, and within <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> mind, only a single thought lingers...
aa3b3213-2fec-4ba2-904f-4a6ba58b7c2d/Eve.cn: 忽然，<NL>便在这无间尽头，玄石破开，血灰弥漫，<NL>一道黑影缓缓浮现，身形渐长、渐巨，<NL>终至上摩苍穹，下踏黄泉，现出一双血目，如日如月，照临万方，<NL><NL>然那巨影凝然不动，仿佛自开天辟地，便已屹立于此，亘古未移，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />遥望巨影，冥冥之中，心中唯有一念……

aa3b3213-2fec-4ba2-904f-4a6ba58b7c2d/Opt.en: (Move toward the colossal shadow, beyond control...)
aa3b3213-2fec-4ba2-904f-4a6ba58b7c2d/Opt.ru: (Двигайтесь к колоссальной тени, не поддающейся контролю...)

3bf3b1f2-85ca-4c66-b9be-bedeabd6fec7/Eve.en: Beneath the moonlit blossoms, a faint fragrance lingers in the air. <NL>Overcome by emotion, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> shares a night of intimacy with <Character key=Fling str=Name/>...

a1f6175b-d001-4870-a28c-6bf4f0316f6a/Eve.cn: 但见巨人垂死之躯，竟生无穷变化——<NL><NL>头颅化作巨岳，双目升作日月；<NL>发髭散作星辰，皮毛变作草木；<NL>筋脉蜿蜒而下，是成山川地理；肌肉连连隆起，遂成田土沃野；<NL>齿骨结为金石，沉入大地地脉；精髓凝为珠玉，埋于深山大泽；<NL>自此山川既成，日月始明，江河奔流，草木滋生……

6346df4a-9867-4333-90d1-19038f32a331/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> drifts without anchor between heaven and earth, <NL>watching the birth, growth, and endless proliferation of all existence through endless ages...<NL>After what feels like countless years, exhaustion finally overtakes <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />. And <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> falls into a deep sleep...
6346df4a-9867-4333-90d1-19038f32a331/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />无所托身，飘摇天地之间，<NL>目送日月交替，星辰起落，眼见生灵诞生，往来繁衍，<NL>如是百年，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />终是力竭神疲，沉沉睡去……

60f97cfe-0c08-4fcf-b940-a4c7a96b8f9d/Eve.en: A beam of golden light pierces the darkness. <NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> awakens at last. <NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> opens the eyes—only to see the end of heaven and earth.<NL>The sky collapses, the earth shatters, and the seas fall into darkness.<NL>The cosmos breaks apart, leaving no light behind.<NL><NL>Then, through a tear in the heavens—<NL>a colossal shadow wielding eight mountain-sized arms, striking at the collapsing firmament with the force of creation itself. <NL>At that moment, ten thousand beams of golden light descend. Golden threads extend from beyond the heavens, forming a radiant bridge across the sky.<NL>At its end stands a figure in white, gazing down upon the world, with armor-like formations drifting behind like frost and clouds...
60f97cfe-0c08-4fcf-b940-a4c7a96b8f9d/Eve.cn: 一道金光，破开黑暗，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />方始惊醒，<NL>睁开双眼，却似已见天地终结之时——<NL>天沦地崩，四海冥合，<NL>乾坤破坏，无复光明，<NL><NL>又见那苍天裂处，黑灰纷纷，<NL>一个巨大的黑影挥动着八条山峦般的臂膀，以开天辟地之势直取苍穹，<NL>便在这时，万道金光落下，紧接着无数金丝自天外垂落，结成光桥，直通天际，<NL>金丝尽头，一白衣之人睥睨而立，身后甲胄如霜，列阵若云……

94198f98-aa2a-42c4-aa6a-920cfc014994/Eve.en: In the East Sea, <NL>multicolored radiance spreads across the heavens.<NL>There, a colossal shadow appears. A serpent-like tail coils beneath a body of unfathomable height. Azure energy swirls around her.<NL>She gazes upon this shattered world. In her eyes lies only boundless compassion.<NL><NL>"All living beings were born of Pangu, and each should follow its own path.<NL>Yet this demon was born from Pangu's heart, the first trace of desire between heaven and earth, the primeval fiend of all fiends. <NL>It devours mountains and rivers, consumes all living things, seeking an endless expansion of existence..."
94198f98-aa2a-42c4-aa6a-920cfc014994/Eve.cn: 东海之处，<NL>五彩霞光铺展，瑞霭祥云氤氲，<NL>却见好一道巨影，蛇尾盘踞，身量万丈，周身青气缭绕，<NL>她头颅轻垂，望向此间残破天地，眸中尽是悲悯之色：<NL><NL>“吾等万灵，皆因盘古而生，本应各循其道，<NL>然而此魔化自盘古心脏，长于天地间第一缕欲念，是为万古第一妖魔，<NL>故吞山河、食草木、啖鸟兽、噬虫鱼，欲求无穷天地……”

3f8d2df0-9996-4675-96c4-b9da5925a28a/Eve.en: "My Eight Trigrams realm stands beyond the Three Realms. <NL>I forge it as a furnace, and take divine fire as fuel, enough to refine even the most unholy of demons."<NL><NL>Its voice echoes through the void.<NL>Behind Fuxi, a Yin-Yang diagram slowly emerges,<NL>expanding as the Eight Trigrams take form one by one.<NL>By the time the final one falls, the Eight Trigrams have already spread across heaven and earth,<NL>descending like a celestial hand that swallows the colossal shadow whole. <NL><NL>Then, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> is seized by an overwhelming force. <NL>In an instant, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> is displaced from the world itself. <NL>Within a boundless void, only the eternal cycle of Yin and Yang continues to flow.
3f8d2df0-9996-4675-96c4-b9da5925a28a/Eve.cn: “吾之八卦化境，超脱三界外，<NL>今以此境为炉，引神火为薪，当可炼化妖魔。”<NL><NL>语声回荡之间，<NL>一尾阴阳双鱼图自伏羲身后缓缓浮现，<NL>渐而乾、坤、坎、离、震、艮、巽、兑之象，一一显化，<NL>及至伏羲最后一字落下，八卦之象已然倾天盖地，<NL>好似一只巨掌轰然落下，将那妖魔巨影尽数遮没，<NL><NL>旋即，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />只觉一股巨力猛然攫来，<NL>瞬息之间，自己竟已置身于一方虚空之中——<NL>四周茫茫荡荡，无天无地，唯余阴阳双鱼流转不息……

3a0e7a34-fb5e-4d97-b252-f453458f4596/Eve.en: Fuxi stands within it, raising divine fire.<NL>Where it falls, flames erupt and spread without restraint, devouring the Yin-Yang cycle in an instant.<NL>In moments, the entire realm becomes a sea of fire, no different from a furnace.<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> suddenly understands.This is Fuxi's intent.<NL>Divine fire cannot be controlled; even a moment's error would burn heaven and earth to ash.<NL>Thus, with the Eight Trigrams, he has carved out this separate realm to destroy the demons...
3a0e7a34-fb5e-4d97-b252-f453458f4596/Eve.cn: 伏羲立于其间，轻扬神火，<NL>火落之处，火舌狂舞，四散蔓延，转眼便将阴阳双鱼尽数吞没，<NL>不过一瞬，此方八卦化境，尽是焚天烈火，已然于洪炉无异……<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />心头一凛，顿明伏羲之意：<NL>神火凶威莫测，有不慎便会焚毁天地，<NL>故伏羲以八卦之力辟出这一方独立之境，炼化魔祟……

768e3f90-9950-46c0-997f-6608f07ca544/Eve.en: "In the realm... I witnessed... a 'human'...<NL>One who came from the mortal world, named Taiwu... A bearer of power never seen since antiquity, who aided me in subduing the demon...<NL>I have traversed countless ages and observed all beneath heaven and earth, yet never have I seen such a being...<NL>That 'human' may be the hope of what is yet to come...<NL>Nüwa... you must find that one..."
768e3f90-9950-46c0-997f-6608f07ca544/Eve.cn: “吾于化境所见……一‘人’……<NL>自人间而来……名唤太吾……怀亘古未有之力，助吾降服妖魔……<NL>吾历经千古，遍观天地……从未得见如此生灵……<NL>那‘人’……或许便是天地……未来之希望……<NL>娲皇……定要寻得那人……”

129cbb7e-8e26-417f-8f1e-cb93c0e2d45b/Eve.en: "What brotherhood is worth more than gold?"<NL>"To die beneath a beauty's gaze is still a lover's fate..." <NL>"How can one not seek immortality, even at the cost of all wealth and fortune?"<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> follows the voices, and the mortal world unfolds.<NL>Some kill kin for gold. Some abandon family for desire. Some spend everything in pursuit of immortality.<NL>Craving surges like a tide, threatening to swallow <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> mind...
129cbb7e-8e26-417f-8f1e-cb93c0e2d45b/Eve.cn: “什么手足之情，哪里抵得上真金白银？”<NL>“牡丹花下死，做鬼也风流……”<NL>“何得长生不死术，岂甘此身归尘土？”<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />循声望去，似见红尘万象——<NL>有人贪求金钱，残杀手足；有人贪求美色，抛妻弃子，有人贪求长生，散尽家财，<NL>一时之间，种种贪念如潮涌来，几乎要将<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />心神吞没……

e039928f-afb5-4b23-a44d-c2e66658eb98/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> grips Fuyu and moves forward slowly.<NL>Then, comes rage.<NL><NL>"Why does heaven treat me so unjustly!"<NL>"I am no worse than him—yet cast aside like refuse!"<NL>"This betrayal will be repaid a hundredfold!"<NL><NL>Across the world, countless voices of resentment rise.<NL>Some curse heaven. Some drown in unwilling hatred. Some cling to unending grievance.<NL>And all of it condenses into obsession...
e039928f-afb5-4b23-a44d-c2e66658eb98/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />握持伏虞，缓步前行，<NL>耳畔忽又有嗔怒之声此起彼伏——<NL><NL>“天道不公，为何偏偏如此待我！”<NL>“我哪里不如他？你却要弃我如敝履……既负我真心！定教你万劫不复！”<NL>“今日所受之辱，他日必当百倍奉还，不死不休！”<NL><NL>世间万千失意人，<NL>或痛斥苍天；或满腔不甘；或恨海难平，<NL>诸般嗔怒之心，终作无穷执念……

e039928f-afb5-4b23-a44d-c2e66658eb98/Opt.en: (Hatred among all beings unsettles the mind...)
e039928f-afb5-4b23-a44d-c2e66658eb98/Opt.cn: （闻听众生嗔欲，一时心神动摇……）
e039928f-afb5-4b23-a44d-c2e66658eb98/Opt.ru: (Ненависть между всеми существами выбивает разум из колеи...)

3ca3bc6e-5603-4f3d-a050-285deb6ef449/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> presses forward with difficulty. Time loses meaning. <NL>Before <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderObject/>, figures begin to emerge... <NL>A maiden sits alone by the window of her boudoir. A swordsman stands with blade in hand, gazing into an empty distance.<NL>An old man stares at a wooden carving, eyes unblinking in death...<NL><NL>"Like illness... like madness... neither waking nor dreaming. Who could ever understand this sorrow..."<NL>"Fifty years with the sword... and at last it is mastered... yet where are my wife and children now..."<NL>"A lifetime carving the 'Homage to the Phoenix'... and still, I can never bring its eyes to life..."<NL><NL>Voices of greed, hatred, and delusion bind the mind like invisible chains...
3ca3bc6e-5603-4f3d-a050-285deb6ef449/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />勉力前行，不知过了多久，<NL>身前便又浮现出一道道人影——<NL>少女独倚妆楼，神容憔悴；侠士仗剑而立，四顾茫茫，<NL>老者凝望木雕，死不瞑目……<NL><NL>“如病如痴，无昏无晓，满怀愁何人知晓……”<NL>“这一剑，我练了五十年，终于成了……可我的妻儿，又去了何处……”<NL>“这百鸟朝凤，我雕了一辈子……怎么就是雕不好这双眼睛……”<NL><NL>一路行来，贪嗔痴欲，声声入耳，缠缚心神……

3ca3bc6e-5603-4f3d-a050-285deb6ef449/Opt.en: (Steady the inner mind and move forward...)

5bd95c18-c7a4-4e31-9d68-04a75c322afe/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> suddenly looks up, struck by a jolt of realization. <NL>Three figures stand suspended in the air, bearing the exact same face and body.<NL>Had it not been for their differing auras and insubstantial outlines, they would be indistinguishable from reflections in a mirror...
5bd95c18-c7a4-4e31-9d68-04a75c322afe/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />猛地抬头，登时心头一震——<NL>只见三道与自己容貌、身形一般无二的身影，凌空而立，<NL>若非神态殊异、身形飘渺，倒好似揽镜自照……

5bd95c18-c7a4-4e31-9d68-04a75c322afe/Opt.en: What manner of evil dares take my form?!
5bd95c18-c7a4-4e31-9d68-04a75c322afe/Opt.cn: 何处来的妖魔外道，竟敢化作我的模样？！
5bd95c18-c7a4-4e31-9d68-04a75c322afe/Opt.ru: Что за зло посмело принять мой облик?!

c2bd681b-b82b-4452-8025-a48a029c470d/Eve.en: "Why..." <NL>The figure standing before <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> paces back and forth, <NL>its expression overflowing with greed and confusion.<NL><NL>"You are the Taiwu Successor—a mere mortal, fragile as an ant. And yet you seek to master all arts of the world, to stand above all ages, to destroy Xiangshu and bring order to the world.<NL>Should you not crave martial knowledge above all else, seeking every profound technique?<NL>Should you not crave fame, calculating every move until your name shakes all?<NL>Should you not crave wealth, seizing all wealth from the living world?<NL>For such a path... you should stop at nothing. No cost should be too great!"<NL><NL>It suddenly stops pacing, staring directly at <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />. Its voice trembles.<NL>"In all the world, if anyone should embody greed to its fullest, it should be you.<NL>Yet why... why is there so little of it within you?"
c2bd681b-b82b-4452-8025-a48a029c470d/Eve.cn: “为何……为何……”<NL>立于<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />前方、神情贪婪之人不住地原地踱步，<NL>眼中满是困惑不解：<NL><NL>“你太吾传人，一介凡人，蝼蚁微力，欲穷万世法、为天下先，诛相枢、定四海，<NL>岂能不贪求武学，四处奔走钻营，遍览精妙之法，<NL>贪求声名，江湖机关算尽，以令名扬天下，<NL>贪求财富，贾市运筹帷幄，尽揽苍生之财，<NL>为此一念，你便该不择手段，不计代价！”<NL><NL>那人猛地顿住脚步，直直看向<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />，颤声问道：<NL>“普天之下，若论贪之极，本当无人能及你太吾！<NL>可为何……为何……你心中那点贪念少得可怜……”

b3bf785d-fa85-42b7-9d27-a83cea1a34c3/Eve.en: "Pathetic!"<NL>A furious voice erupts from behind. <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> turns.<NL>A figure filled with rage stands close, its form trembling as if on the verge of collapse.<NL><NL>"Why do you not rage? Why do you not hate?<NL>Xiangshu brings ruin upon the world, slaughtering all beings,<NL>and yet the fate of all rests upon your shoulders. Success is expected of you. Failure is yours alone to bear. How can you not feel anger?<NL>Since stepping into this Martial World, have you not seen suffering everywhere, the innocent crushed, justice trampled? And yet the world remains unjust, how can you not hate it?<NL>I curse you, I scorn you, and still you feel no anger, no hatred!<NL>How could you possibly call yourself the Successor of Taiwu?"
b3bf785d-fa85-42b7-9d27-a83cea1a34c3/Eve.cn: “好没血气！”<NL>身后一声怒斥炸开，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />闻言回首，<NL>但见那怒容满面之人已凑至面前，身形似是气得飘摇不定：<NL><NL>“你为何不怒、为何不恨！<NL>相枢为祸，屠戮生灵，彼辈苍生，<NL>却将天下安危，尽付你身，成是你责，败为你祸，你焉能不怒？<NL>自你行走江湖，又哪一日不见苍生受苦、良善蒙难，天道如斯不公，你焉能不恨？<NL>我骂你、斥你，你也不怒、也不恨！<NL>这般窝囊，配做什么太吾传人？！”

b3bf785d-fa85-42b7-9d27-a83cea1a34c3/Opt.en: Greed... Hatred... could this be... (Glance to the side...)
b3bf785d-fa85-42b7-9d27-a83cea1a34c3/Opt.cn: 贪……嗔……莫非乃是我心中三毒所化……（看向身侧之人……）
b3bf785d-fa85-42b7-9d27-a83cea1a34c3/Opt.ru: Жадность... Ненависть... могло ли это быть... (Взгляд в сторону...)

db4f0d07-e961-4139-9ed6-b0c4776c4c25/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> turns gaze to the figure beside. <NL>There, the figure born of delusion drifts like mist, wavering between form and formlessness.<NL>Its face cannot be seen clearly. Only a pair of eyes look back through the haze, filled with lingering obsession.<NL><NL> "A single moon reflected in ten thousand rivers... yet in one heart, there is no separation.<NL>Only I understand you...<NL><NL>Cold nights, moon and stars...<NL>Death-bound trials, never retreat...<NL>You bear the Fuyu Hilt, inherit Taiwu's name, and carry the will to destroy Xiangshu.<NL>By now, you should know that one must do what seems impossible, and walk paths that seem unwalkable.<NL>And yet... why are you never consumed by fixation?"
db4f0d07-e961-4139-9ed6-b0c4776c4c25/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />下意识看向身侧，<NL>只见那痴念所化之人身形飘飘渺渺，似烟似雾，<NL>看不清面目，只觉一双眸子幽幽望来，满是痴缠：<NL><NL>“一水千江月，一心本无别，<NL>天下之大，唯我知君……<NL><NL>多少寒夜，星月为伴，仗剑独行，<NL>多少险境，十死一生，未有退却，<NL>你握持「伏虞剑柄」，传承太吾之名，诛灭相枢之志，<NL>一路而来，本当知不可为而为之，知不可行而行之，<NL>然你为何……从不执迷……”

db4f0d07-e961-4139-9ed6-b0c4776c4c25/Opt.en: What is your purpose in appearing here?
db4f0d07-e961-4139-9ed6-b0c4776c4c25/Opt.cn: 你等现身于此，到底意欲何为……
db4f0d07-e961-4139-9ed6-b0c4776c4c25/Opt.ru: С какой целью вы здесь появились?

6c63c774-f913-4b2d-8b0f-dc7e1da11c09/Eve.en: "We were formed from the dark flames devouring the 'demonic blood'.<NL>Yet because you possess no fixation, no desire, we have been unable to descend into this world.<NL>In this sea of desire, only now have we gathered what remains of our strength, forming this body to stand before you... for a single question."<NL><NL>The voice of delusion drifts through the void, faint and wavering...
6c63c774-f913-4b2d-8b0f-dc7e1da11c09/Eve.cn: “我等因黑焰吞吃‘魔血’成形，<NL>却因你无所执、无所求，而难以降世，<NL>至此欲海，终能穷尽余力，凝出此身，行至君前，只为一问……”<NL><NL>痴念之声幽幽传来，似远似近，如风中残烛，摇曳不定……

6c63c774-f913-4b2d-8b0f-dc7e1da11c09/Opt.en: What is the origin of this "demonic blood"? How does it allow you to take form?
6c63c774-f913-4b2d-8b0f-dc7e1da11c09/Opt.cn: “魔血”何种来历，为何可助你等成形？
6c63c774-f913-4b2d-8b0f-dc7e1da11c09/Opt.ru: Каково происхождение этой "демонической крови"? Как это позволяет вам принимать форму?

6c63c774-f913-4b2d-8b0f-dc7e1da11c09/Opt.en: Why can dark flames consume the "demonic blood"...
6c63c774-f913-4b2d-8b0f-dc7e1da11c09/Opt.ru: Почему темное пламя может поглощать "демоническую кровь"?..

6c63c774-f913-4b2d-8b0f-dc7e1da11c09/Opt.en: What lies at the end of this place?
6c63c774-f913-4b2d-8b0f-dc7e1da11c09/Opt.cn: 此间尽头，究竟是为何物……
6c63c774-f913-4b2d-8b0f-dc7e1da11c09/Opt.ru: Что находится в конце этого места?

6c63c774-f913-4b2d-8b0f-dc7e1da11c09/Opt.en: What do you seek to ask?

8cc083df-4454-4ed1-be68-19587ef68ae6/Eve.en: "You truly do not know? The Pangu Demonic Blood is the blood of Pangu himself.<NL>Within it lies the first trace of desire born at the dawn of creation.<NL>All beings who come into contact with it will have every hidden desire stirred.<NL>And yet... you remain unmoved."<NL><NL>Greed speaks again, voice trembling, almost unhinged. <NL>"A mere mortal... how can you remain unaffected?"
8cc083df-4454-4ed1-be68-19587ef68ae6/Eve.cn: “你竟不知，那‘盘古魔血’乃是盘古鲜血所化，<NL>其中蕴藏着天地初开之际，诞生的第一缕欲念，<NL>但凡生灵触及，心中诸般欲望，皆会被其引动，无所遁形……<NL>可偏偏是你，无动于衷……”<NL><NL>贪念不住追问，神情几近癫狂：<NL>“一介凡人，血肉之躯，何能……无动于衷？”

d2fe3d19-2c01-405d-8a5f-dfa1cbca40cc/Eve.en: Hatred grows impatient. It shoves delusion aside and <NL>glares wide-eyed at <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />, shouting sharply:<NL><NL>"Enough!<NL>That dark flame is refined by divine fire to suppress Xiangshu. It naturally favors what Xiangshu favors!<NL> Now that you've found the Pangu Demonic Blood, hurry up and devour it!"
d2fe3d19-2c01-405d-8a5f-dfa1cbca40cc/Eve.cn: 嗔念听得不耐，一把推开身旁的痴念，<NL>瞪圆了双眼，厉声朝<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />斥道：<NL><NL>“啰嗦！啰嗦！<NL>那黑焰乃是神火熬炼、压制相枢所炼出的东西，自然喜相枢所喜！<NL>见了这‘盘古魔血’！还不赶紧吃抹干净！”

3dad9a5b-0750-44be-8a51-edbd8d2c1c7e/Eve.cn: “欸？你竟不知，那‘盘古魔血’乃是盘古鲜血所化，<NL>其中蕴藏着天地初开之际，诞生的第一缕欲念，<NL>但凡生灵触及，心中诸般欲望，皆会被其引动，无所遁形……<NL><NL>嘿嘿，每当你心中贪嗔痴念多一分，<NL>那‘盘古魔血’便受你召引而来，<NL>吾等受其滋养，日渐壮大，直至今日——终于降生于世！”<NL><NL>贪念说至最后，竟是双臂大张，狂笑不止，神情几近癫狂……

24049449-2220-4b0a-9d83-91175ec5d7df/Eve.en: "We would take up the Fuyu Hilt in your stead and carry on the name of Taiwu. <NL>The battles ahead, the demons to slay, the countless hardships to endure... leave them all to us. <NL>As for you, wander where you please. Admire the mountains and rivers, savor fine wine, and share your days with a beloved companion. Would that not be a life well lived...?" <NL><NL>Delusion speaks softly, its gaze settling upon the Fuyu Hilt. <NL> The meaning behind its words is clear: it wishes for <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> to relinquish the Fuyu Hilt. <NL>The three of them would bear the mantle of Taiwu, carry on the legacy, and walk the path that was meant to be <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderObject/>...

Clean and simple!"<NL>Hatred steps closer, its eyes burning red as it fixes <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> with an unblinking stare. <NL>Each word falls from its lips like the whisper of a demon: <NL><NL> "I've long since grown sick of them.<NL>Rid this world of mankind, and every thought dies with them.
