16cff74d-05a5-4f6f-9a1a-767da9b22e7e/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />抬首望去，神情倨傲，掷地有声……<NL><NL>三道身影闻言，登时发出阵阵嗤笑：<NL>“乾坤独断，苍生臣服？”<NL>“哈哈！凡人之见，可笑至极！<NL>“君心如此，可怪不得吾等了……”<NL><NL>其话音方落，周身便即涌出滚滚黑雾，翻涌席卷，<NL>不过眨眼之间，百里玄石、遍地血灰尽被吞没，最后便连那道巨影，也融入一片黑暗之中……

c14e688a-b24a-4ad7-ac6e-25ef97c6e69d/Eve.en: "Hmm... <NL>I have existed here since time immemorial. Nothing else has ever been seen...<NL>Then where does this come from..."<NL><NL>The giant raises its hands and slowly brings its fingers together, <NL>cupping <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> in its palm as if holding a drifting feather, a grain of dust.<NL>It looks down at <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />. A fleeting hint of confusion passes through its eyes, strangely human in its simplicity.
c14e688a-b24a-4ad7-ac6e-25ef97c6e69d/Eve.cn: “嗯？<NL>吾于此间，独处万古，不见他物，<NL>一点心念……从何而来……”<NL><NL>巨人缓缓探出双掌，十指轻轻合拢，<NL>将<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />捧在掌心，如掬一片飘零的羽毛，如托一粒微小的尘埃，<NL>他垂首凝望<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />，眼中闪过一丝茫然，神情竟与凡人别无二致……

c14e688a-b24a-4ad7-ac6e-25ef97c6e69d/Opt.en: My name is Taiwu. I come from the human world...
c14e688a-b24a-4ad7-ac6e-25ef97c6e69d/Opt.cn: 我名唤太吾，乃是自人间而来……
c14e688a-b24a-4ad7-ac6e-25ef97c6e69d/Opt.ru: Меня зовут Тайу. Я родом из мира людей...

ae6b7039-7449-494b-9857-ab0ff0625d02/Eve.en: "Taiwu... the human world... beyond all things...<NL>Do you mean... there are other realms beyond this one?"<NL><NL>The giant murmurs to itself. Its voice rolls like distant thunder, slowly echoing through the void. Deep within its eyes, faint ripples begin to stir...
ae6b7039-7449-494b-9857-ab0ff0625d02/Eve.cn: “太吾……人间……物外……<NL>你道除此一境，还有他方？”<NL><NL>巨人喃喃而语，声若闷雷，缓缓滚动，眼底深处，隐隐泛起微澜……
ae6b7039-7449-494b-9857-ab0ff0625d02/Eve.ru: - Тайу... человеческий мир... за пределами всего сущего...<NL>Ты имеешь в виду... что есть другие миры за пределами этого?"<NL><NL>Великан что-то бормочет сам себе. Его голос раскатывается подобно отдаленному грому, медленно отдаваясь эхом в пустоте. Глубоко в его глазах начинает шевелиться слабая рябь...

ae6b7039-7449-494b-9857-ab0ff0625d02/Opt.en: So that is how it is... My existence is different from this place...
ae6b7039-7449-494b-9857-ab0ff0625d02/Opt.cn: 便是如此，我之所在，与此处大不相同……
ae6b7039-7449-494b-9857-ab0ff0625d02/Opt.ru: Так вот как это бывает... Мое существование отличается от этого места...

607816e8-acfd-4f94-8da6-f032c6f6c4bf/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />At the thought of it, blurry images emerge in my mind...
607816e8-acfd-4f94-8da6-f032c6f6c4bf/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />言念及此，一些朦胧景象忽而浮上心头……
607816e8-acfd-4f94-8da6-f032c6f6c4bf/Eve.ru: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />При мысли об этом в моем сознании возникают размытые образы...

607816e8-acfd-4f94-8da6-f032c6f6c4bf/Opt.en: Wherever I am, towering mountains rise to the sky, sheer ravines cut through the land, and mighty rivers surge into the sea.
607816e8-acfd-4f94-8da6-f032c6f6c4bf/Opt.cn: 我之所在，自有群山万壑，峙立乾坤，百川归海，奔流不息！
607816e8-acfd-4f94-8da6-f032c6f6c4bf/Opt.ru: Где бы я ни был, высокие горы вздымаются к небу, отвесные ущелья прорезают землю, а могучие реки впадают в море.

607816e8-acfd-4f94-8da6-f032c6f6c4bf/Opt.en: Where I am, villages come alive with smoke curling from kitchen chimneys and simple joys soothing the soul.
607816e8-acfd-4f94-8da6-f032c6f6c4bf/Opt.cn: 我之所在，自有村墟闾巷，人间烟火，至味清欢，最抚人心……
607816e8-acfd-4f94-8da6-f032c6f6c4bf/Opt.ru: Там, где я нахожусь, деревни оживают от дыма, вьющегося из кухонных труб, и простых радостей, успокаивающих душу.

607816e8-acfd-4f94-8da6-f032c6f6c4bf/Opt.en: Where I am, the sun rises as the moon and stars fade, and sets as they rise again, painting dawn and dusk in an endless cycle.
607816e8-acfd-4f94-8da6-f032c6f6c4bf/Opt.cn: 我之所在，自有日月星辰，轮转不息，朝晖夕阴，气象万千……
607816e8-acfd-4f94-8da6-f032c6f6c4bf/Opt.ru: Там, где я нахожусь, солнце восходит, когда меркнут луна и звезды, и заходит, когда они снова восходят, рисуя рассвет и сумерки в бесконечном цикле.

607816e8-acfd-4f94-8da6-f032c6f6c4bf/Opt.en: Where I am, I enjoy fine wine among blossoms, live a carefree life, and take delight in cricket fighting.
607816e8-acfd-4f94-8da6-f032c6f6c4bf/Opt.cn: 我之所在，自有花间美酒，纵意平生，促织斗戏，其乐无穷！
607816e8-acfd-4f94-8da6-f032c6f6c4bf/Opt.ru: Там, где я нахожусь, я наслаждаюсь прекрасным вином среди цветов, живу беззаботной жизнью и получаю удовольствие от боя в Сверчок.

607816e8-acfd-4f94-8da6-f032c6f6c4bf/Opt.en: Where I am, all beings are sheltered beneath the boundless sky and carried upon the vast earth.
607816e8-acfd-4f94-8da6-f032c6f6c4bf/Opt.cn: 我之所在，自有天覆万物，地载群生，大而无极，广而无边！
607816e8-acfd-4f94-8da6-f032c6f6c4bf/Opt.ru: Там, где я нахожусь, все существа укрыты под бескрайним небом и перенесены на необъятную землю.

1a42981e-2b80-4395-9ba0-c0a38c5fa4a0/Eve.en: The giant listened intently.<NL>A faint light flickered in his once clouded eyes.<NL><NL>Suddenly, he moved.<NL>He lifted his shoulder slightly, but struck the unseen ceiling above. He stretched his legs downward, only to meet an unseen boundary below.<NL>Realizing this, the giant looked around this chaos and murmured:<NL>"Taiwu... is this realm narrow or vast?" <NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> gazed at the giant, who sat curled like a stone statue,<NL> as if he had remained thus since the very beginning.
1a42981e-2b80-4395-9ba0-c0a38c5fa4a0/Eve.cn: 巨人听得入神，<NL>那双混沌不明的双眸，渐而泛起一丝光亮，<NL><NL>忽然，巨人动了一动，<NL>微微抬了抬肩膀，便撞上头顶屏障，稍稍伸了伸腿，却触到了脚下边界，<NL>巨人似是意识到了什么，举目环顾这方混沌，不由喃喃问道：<NL>“太吾……你道此处，狭也？广也？”<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />见那巨人蜷缩此间，浑如石像，<NL>仿佛亘古以来，唯有方才动了一动……

1a42981e-2b80-4395-9ba0-c0a38c5fa4a0/Opt.en: To me, it is vast for it imposes no limits on me; To you, it is narrow for it confines you...
1a42981e-2b80-4395-9ba0-c0a38c5fa4a0/Opt.cn: 此地于我无拘无碍，可称之广，于你身不自由，自然是狭……
1a42981e-2b80-4395-9ba0-c0a38c5fa4a0/Opt.ru: Для меня она обширна, потому что не накладывает на меня никаких ограничений; для вас она узка, потому что ограничивает вас...

f3e53d88-80c0-4a8c-b2a1-8cd9562d8202/Eve.en: The giant fell silent for a long while.<NL>Then he nodded, suddenly sat upright and gently placed <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />upon his shoulder.<NL>In that instant, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> could not tell what he would do...
f3e53d88-80c0-4a8c-b2a1-8cd9562d8202/Eve.cn: 巨人听闻此言，沉默许久，<NL>终是点了点头，猛地坐起身来，将<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />轻轻放于肩头，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />一时不知他意欲何为……
f3e53d88-80c0-4a8c-b2a1-8cd9562d8202/Eve.ru: Великан надолго замолчал.<NL>Затем он кивнул, внезапно выпрямился и осторожно положил <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />на его плече.<NL>В это мгновение, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> не мог сказать, что он будет делать...

4d994f32-a840-488e-b699-d190474ca1fd/Eve.en: "I did not see it until you came.<NL>Only now do I find that these limbs of mine can scarcely stretch." <NL><NL>The giant bellowed, his thunderous voice shaking the primordial void.<NL>He lifted both hands, pressing upward against the unseen ceiling.<NL>With knees and feet braced against the ground, he thrust himself upward. His bones cracked loudly, stirring the surrounding chaos.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> was utterly focused, and dared not move. Then came a faint crack, almost too soft to hear.<NL>As the rift was torn open in the chaos, a sliver of light spilled into the void...
4d994f32-a840-488e-b699-d190474ca1fd/Eve.cn: “你来之前，未有此念，<NL>适才方觉这身筋骨，实难舒展！”<NL><NL>巨人朗声一喝，声震混沌，<NL>他双手奋力举起，掌心向上，托住头顶那片无形屏障，<NL>膝足撑地，脊背猛然向上一抬，骨骼格格作响，震得周遭混沌之气微微激荡，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />屏气凝神，不敢稍动，随后只听得一声几不可闻的脆响，<NL>但见混沌之间，竟而裂开一丝缝隙，一线微光，透入此间……

3958c15b-06d2-4815-ae04-afe79cea1a17/Eve.en: With both hands raised to the sky and feet firmly planted on the earth, the giant stood like a pillar in the realm.<NL>With a final forceful lift, the realm split open.<NL><NL>Light and clear things gradually rose and became the sky,<NL>while heavy and turbid things sank and formed the earth.<NL>That's how sky and earth were separated. <NL>sky and earth were set in order as primordial chaos was split open; all creation came to being henceforth!
3958c15b-06d2-4815-ae04-afe79cea1a17/Eve.cn: 巨人双手高举，双足一撑，身子便如四极天柱，拔地而起，<NL>此方混沌，豁然裂开一道巨口，<NL><NL>阳清之气，冉冉上升，化作天，<NL>阴浊之气，沉沉下坠，凝为地，<NL>正是“混沌初开天地分，清升浊降始为真。<NL>鸿蒙一破乾坤定，造化由来自此根”！

3958c15b-06d2-4815-ae04-afe79cea1a17/Opt.en: As primordial chaos first split open, sky and earth were set in order. This... looks strangely familiar...
3958c15b-06d2-4815-ae04-afe79cea1a17/Opt.cn: 混沌初开，乾坤始奠……这般景象，好生熟悉……
3958c15b-06d2-4815-ae04-afe79cea1a17/Opt.ru: Когда первозданный хаос впервые раскололся, небо и земля были приведены в порядок. Это... выглядит странно знакомым...

3fda6081-94a9-4bea-8433-fdf2be1c4e86/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> felt as if he had seen it before.<NL>Yet his mind, long adrift, and his memories, shrouded in mist, offered nothing clear to grasp.<NL>He cast the thoughts aside and looked once more toward the giant who upheld sky and earth.<NL><NL>The giant upheld the sky above and stood firm upon the earth.<NL>His body strained beneath the weight of the world, sweat pouring down like rain.<NL>Yet his eyes, once clouded in chaos, now gleamed like the sun.
3fda6081-94a9-4bea-8433-fdf2be1c4e86/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />只觉此情此景，似曾相识，<NL>然而或许是心念飘荡已久，记忆混沌，却是如何也想不起来，<NL>索性便抛却杂念，不再多想，转而看向那撑天拄地的巨人——<NL><NL>巨人头顶苍天，足踏大地，<NL>巍巍然立于天地之间，汗珠如雨，纷纷坠落，<NL>一双眼眸，混沌尽去，精光炯炯，恍若日月垂天，遍照四方……

3fda6081-94a9-4bea-8433-fdf2be1c4e86/Opt.en: Splitting open the chaos must have worn you out. Why not rest a while...
3fda6081-94a9-4bea-8433-fdf2be1c4e86/Opt.cn: 开辟混沌，定然力竭神疲，你何不歇息一番……
3fda6081-94a9-4bea-8433-fdf2be1c4e86/Opt.ru: Разгром этого хаоса, должно быть, измотал вас. Почему бы тебе немного не отдохнуть?..

d5bcae65-607c-46c0-b55e-23e56e0eaf7f/Eve.en: "I have rested long enough!" <NL><NL>The giant stood motionless, pushing the sky upwards and the ground downwards.<NL>Day after day, as sky rose higher one zhang and earth sank deeper one zhang, the giant grew one zhang taller.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> remained upon his shoulder, talking to him to pass the time,<NL>while the giant said little in return...
d5bcae65-607c-46c0-b55e-23e56e0eaf7f/Eve.cn: “吾睡了许久，已足够了！”<NL><NL>巨人撑天拄地，不移不动，<NL>天日高一丈，地日厚一丈，巨人随之日长一丈，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />便立于巨人肩头，与巨人说话解闷，<NL>而巨人多半时候只沉默着，偶尔低低应一声……

b5966a66-8bb9-4c6b-b437-56f6e30e7d68/Eve.en: As to how long it had been, none could tell.<NL>Until one day, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />suddenly felt a tremor beneath him and awoke.<NL>He looked around,only to find that the sky above and earth below were beyond sight.<NL>Between them spanned ninety thousand zhang.
b5966a66-8bb9-4c6b-b437-56f6e30e7d68/Eve.cn: 如此不知过了多久，<NL>这一日，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />忽觉身下颤动，方始惊醒，<NL>举目四望，但见天极高远，上不见其顶；地极深邃，下不见其底，<NL>天地相去，竟有九万丈遥……
b5966a66-8bb9-4c6b-b437-56f6e30e7d68/Eve.ru: Никто не мог сказать, сколько времени это продолжалось.<NL>Пока однажды, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />внезапно он почувствовал дрожь под собой и проснулся.<NL>Он огляделся по сторонам только для того, чтобы обнаружить, что небо вверху и земля внизу находятся за пределами видимости.<NL>Между ними простиралось девяносто тысяч чжан.

b5966a66-8bb9-4c6b-b437-56f6e30e7d68/Opt.en: (The giant stood alone between sky and earth for an immeasurable span of time...)
b5966a66-8bb9-4c6b-b437-56f6e30e7d68/Opt.cn: （巨人独立天地，不知多少岁月……）
b5966a66-8bb9-4c6b-b437-56f6e30e7d68/Opt.ru: (Великан стоял один между небом и землей неизмеримый промежуток времени...)

d0a6454f-e3b9-49df-8f59-28763eb420c9/Eve.en: "Taiwu... is this space narrow or vast?" <NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />followed the sound, looked up,<NL>and saw the giant's slightly stooped figure, and uncontrollably trembling hands that upheld the sky.<NL>With every breath he took, sky and earth shuddered in response.<NL><NL>At last... as if even sky and earth had their limits, his divine strength, too, was not without end.<NL>The giant had stood holding up the sky and standing on the earth for an immeasurable stretch of time until <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />was awoke, and exhausted every last trace of his strength...
d0a6454f-e3b9-49df-8f59-28763eb420c9/Eve.cn: “太吾……你道此处，狭也？广也？”<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />循声望去，<NL>只见巨人身影微微佝偻，举天之手战栗不止，<NL>一呼一吸之间，便连天地亦随之震颤，<NL><NL>终是……天地有时而尽，神力亦有穷时，<NL>巨人撑天拄地，不知几许岁月，终至<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />醒来这一刻，耗尽了所有气力……

d0a6454f-e3b9-49df-8f59-28763eb420c9/Opt.en: This realm is so vast that neither sky above nor earth below can be seen to their limits. Here, you would be free...
d0a6454f-e3b9-49df-8f59-28763eb420c9/Opt.cn: 此间极广，天高无极，地厚无垠，你于此间，定可无拘无碍……
d0a6454f-e3b9-49df-8f59-28763eb420c9/Opt.ru: Это царство настолько обширно, что ни небо вверху, ни земля внизу не могут быть видны до их пределов. Здесь вы были бы свободны...

acaf48ac-4366-40ce-8769-f887cfaf05b7/Eve.en: The giant fell silent for a long moment upon hearing this.<NL>Suddenly, as if something had occurred to him, he lowered the arms that had been holding up the sky, and slowly said:<NL>"Splitting open chaos and creating the world are my will"<NL><NL>Before his words had even faded, he fell to the earth with a thunderous crash.<NL>In that instant, heaven and earth shook, and the cosmos fell into primal confusion.<NL>Dust and debris billowed like waves, and the four poles of the world groaned...
acaf48ac-4366-40ce-8769-f887cfaf05b7/Eve.cn: 巨人闻言，默然良久，<NL>忽然，他似乎想到了什么，放下了撑持天地的双臂，缓缓说道：<NL>“开天辟地，化育万物……此为吾之愿也……”<NL><NL>巨人话音未落，就此轰然倒地，<NL>一时之间，天地动摇，乾坤混茫，<NL>尘埃翻涌如浪，四极隐隐作响……

c7c1efd0-052a-4cd5-a67c-ea9793c6f9d1/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> had not expected what would come to pass.<NL>Though the giant's body had become mountains, rivers, and all things, the will to split heaven and earth still remained unextinguished.<NL>It sank into his blood and flowed into the deepest rivers, hidden from sight.<NL> It was born within his heart, giving rise to lingering dark aura.<NL>Over the course of a thousand years, it gradually took form, and eventually became a demon...
c7c1efd0-052a-4cd5-a67c-ea9793c6f9d1/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />岂知后来，<NL>巨人身躯虽化作山川万物，然那“开天辟地”的欲念却未消弭，<NL>融于鲜血，归向九泉，隐而不见；<NL>凝于心脏，生出黑气，缭绕不去，<NL>历经千年，竟而渐渐凝作实体，化作妖魔……

6b47c8fc-50fb-4b7f-8741-d0f3cf8cd4d9/Eve.en:
It had twelve monstrous eyes that saw across the Three Realms,<NL>
eight colossal arms that seized the farthest reaches of heaven and earth,<NL>and a mouth that devoured all beings.<NL>It devoured mountains, leaving the earth shattered and swallowing beasts and birds.<NL>It drank rivers, exhausting the waters and swallowing fish and dragons.<NL>With each bite, it grew over one zhang taller.<NL>Until it became a mountain itself.<NL>Having devoured everything around it, the demon had grown from the size of a colossal elephant into a towering mountain...
6b47c8fc-50fb-4b7f-8741-d0f3cf8cd4d9/Eve.cn: 那妖魔长出十二只怪目，遍览三界变幻，<NL>生出八只巨手，攫取九垓八埏，<NL>又化出一张巨口，吞吃天地万物……<NL><NL>吞山，山崩地裂，禽亡兽绝；<NL>吞河，河干水涸，鱼死龙殁；<NL>那妖魔每吞吃一口，身形便涨大一丈，<NL>及至吞尽周遭万物，妖魔已从万斤巨象，化作丈把山峰……

55baf642-f2dd-4413-bdca-1b92221b3abf/Eve.en: <NL>Time passed beyond measure.<NL>The changing seasons mark the passing of time.<NL>The land sank, the world's four poles crumbled.<NL>After devouring all that remained, the demon had grown ninety thousand zhang in height.<NL><NL>Yet still the heavens were not high enough, nor the earth vast enough.<NL>It raised a foot to shatter the sun and moon, shaking the stars from the sky, and spread its eight arms to tear the firmament apart and rend the clouds.<NL>At last, heaven and earth dimmed, and all creation fell into ruin.<NL><NL>At last, heaven and earth faded into darkness, and all creation sank into ruin.<NL><NL>It reached out his hand once moretoward the void beyond the heavens...
55baf642-f2dd-4413-bdca-1b92221b3abf/Eve.cn: 如此不知多少年月，<NL>日往月来，星移斗换，<NL>神州陆沉，四极崩塌，<NL>妖魔已然吞尽此间万物，长有九万之丈，<NL><NL>然而，妖魔仍觉天不足高，地不足远，<NL>伸出一足踏破了日月，震落星辰，张开八手扯裂了苍穹，撕碎云霞，<NL>终于，乾坤失色，万象沉沦，<NL><NL>妖魔又再探手，欲要向那天幕之后的一片虚无中伸去……

f50a3aa3-dd1f-4dc6-b22d-a66cbfb735ab/Eve.en: "As long as this demon remains unvanquished<NL>, it will one day devour all living beings in the world.<NL>As we bear the duty of stabilizing heaven and earth and protecting living beings,<NL> we shall not permit this fiend to wreak havoc upon the world or slaughter all creatures." <NL><NL>A voice echoed through the world. <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />turned toward the sound, and saw<NL>another colossal figure standing upright across the East Sea. He was dragon-horned and scaled, his eyes burning like torches.<NL>Its two hands formed a ring-like seal, within which clear and turbid Qi cycled endlessly...
f50a3aa3-dd1f-4dc6-b22d-a66cbfb735ab/Eve.cn: “此魔一日不灭，<NL>终将吞吃尽天地万物、亿兆生灵，<NL>吾等既承安定乾坤之责，负护佑苍生之任，<NL>断不容此魔祸乱世间、屠戮生灵。”<NL><NL>一道声音落于天地，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />循声望去，<NL>东海对面，另有一道巨影巍然耸立，龙角鳞身，双目如炬，<NL>两手结印如环，其间清浊之气流转不朽……

c634cd38-fe34-4670-b297-c55dbaa3fa3e/Eve.en: "What a filthy being born of desire."<NL>"It can be eliminated with ease.<NL>I'd say Nüwa and Fuxi worry too much..."<NL><NL>The man in white frowned, as though even the sight of it would defile his eyes, and looked away in disgust.<NL>He turned back and sat upon a high throne of woven gold threads, and lifted his hand slightly...
c634cd38-fe34-4670-b297-c55dbaa3fa3e/Eve.cn: “一点欲念，肮脏至极，<NL>所化区区妖魔，弹指即可覆灭，<NL>我看娲皇、羲皇太也多虑……”<NL><NL>白衣人似是怕这“肮脏”污了双目，眉头微蹙，嫌恶地收回目光，<NL>回身坐于高处金丝座椅上，手掌轻轻一扬……

c634cd38-fe34-4670-b297-c55dbaa3fa3e/Opt.en: (Nüwa...Fuxi... Could it be... Nüwa and Fuxi?)
c634cd38-fe34-4670-b297-c55dbaa3fa3e/Opt.cn: （娲皇……羲皇……莫非乃是……女娲伏羲……）
c634cd38-fe34-4670-b297-c55dbaa3fa3e/Opt.ru: (Нюва... Фуси... Могло ли это быть... Нюва и Фуси?)

706c5e4b-adc6-4493-b53c-5e2d6049838a/Eve.en: In an instant,<NL>a million fully armed and armored celestial soldiers descended from a light bridge.<NL>Golden-armored generals led the charge, halberds in hand and clad in golden scale armor.<NL>Behind them, tens of thousands of heavenly troops charged in disciplined ranks straight toward the eight-armed demon like meteors racing to the moon.<NL>Wherever they advanced, blood and ash retreated. Intertwined strands of golden light wrapped the colossal shadow layer upon layer!
706c5e4b-adc6-4493-b53c-5e2d6049838a/Eve.cn: 刹那之间，<NL>百万天兵天将披坚执锐，自光桥倾泻而下，<NL>金甲神将当先开路，手持长戟，身披金鳞，<NL>其后数万天兵阵列森严，宛若流星赶月，直扑那八臂妖魔而去，<NL>但见所至之处，血灰退散，金光交织，将那巨大的黑影层层裹住！

02566021-7fee-43f2-9d62-80b8a52873e2/Eve.en:
The demon roared in fury,<NL>wielding its eight arms, shattering the earth.<NL>As Nüwa waved her hand, a streak of divine light pierced through the air toward the demon's four hands.<NL>Fuxi thrust both palms forward, sending forth streams of clear and turbid Qi coiled like twin dragons to trap the demon's four arms.<NL><NL>Yet the demon opened its vast maw and swallowed one hundred thousand celestial soldiers in a single gulp.<NL>Its body grew another one thousand zhang taller. Then, with a mighty heave, it tore free of its restraints, seized another hundred thousand soldiers, and stuffed them into its mouth.<NL>The man in white's expression tightened. He rose abruptly and gave a sharp command,
"All forces, eradicate this demon!" <NL><NL>At his command, a thousand deities and Buddhas summoned their divine artifacts, filling the heavens with radiant light!
02566021-7fee-43f2-9d62-80b8a52873e2/Eve.cn: 妖魔怒啸，<NL>八臂挥舞，震得四野崩裂，<NL>女娲玉手一挥，一抹宝光破空而出，直刺妖魔四手，<NL>伏羲双掌齐推，清浊二气如龙缠绕，困住妖魔四臂，<NL><NL>然而妖魔张开巨口，竟一口吞下十万天兵天将，<NL>身形又长千丈，奋力一挣，四只巨臂便即脱困，又伸手抓住十万天兵，如捏蝼蚁般塞入口中，<NL>白衣之人面色微变，霍然起身，厉声下令：<NL>“诸天万法，共诛此獠！”<NL><NL>千名神佛得令，齐齐祭出法宝，一时佛光普照，神器横飞！

8a4382db-18af-4c08-9019-e096cc830dc8/Eve.en: But the demon showed no fear.<NL>With a single sweep of its hand, eight divine beings were snatched into its grasp as though they were clay figurines.<NL>Nüwa let out a sharp cry, and her divine radiance split into countless beams, striking at the demon's monstrous eyes and severing its eight arms.<NL><NL>In pain, the demon pulled back six arms,loosened its grip on the six captured deities.<NL>But the demon, driven into a frenzy, clenched its remaining two massive hands tightly around a Buddha and a deity,<NL>opened its maw and swallowed them whole!
8a4382db-18af-4c08-9019-e096cc830dc8/Eve.cn: 然那妖魔浑然不惧，巨手一挥，<NL>便有八尊神佛被攫入掌中，如抓泥偶，<NL>女娲急叱一声，宝光化作万千光影，直劈妖魔怪目、斩向妖魔八臂，<NL><NL>妖魔吃痛，六臂猛地一缩，攫在掌中的六尊神佛应声跌落，<NL>然那妖魔凶性大发，剩下两只巨掌死死攥住一佛一神，<NL>猛然张口，将之吞吃入腹！

8a4382db-18af-4c08-9019-e096cc830dc8/Opt.en: (The devourer of heaven and earth, slayer of deities and Buddhas, truly the most fearsome demon of all ages...)
8a4382db-18af-4c08-9019-e096cc830dc8/Opt.cn: （吞天食地，杀神灭佛，当真是万古第一妖魔……）
8a4382db-18af-4c08-9019-e096cc830dc8/Opt.ru: (Пожиратель неба и земли, убийца божеств и Будд, поистине самый страшный демон всех времен...)

88e04cad-8a8c-4af7-a455-94a885f9c7d1/Eve.en: Still unsatisfied, it turned its twelve monstrous eyes, NL>locking straight onto the man in white seated high upon his throne. <NL>All eight arms then shot forward to seize him! <NL><NL>"You vile spawn! How dare you defy my authority!" <NL>The man in white let out a clear shout that shook the nine heavens.<NL>Myriads of golden threads surged forth from behind him, binding the demon's eight massive arms.<NL>The demon howled and struggled, then finally broke one arm free, sweeping it toward the man's face.
88e04cad-8a8c-4af7-a455-94a885f9c7d1/Eve.cn: 妖魔吞罢，意犹未尽，十二只怪目齐齐转动，<NL>直直盯住那高处金丝座椅上的白衣人，<NL>八臂齐展，直向那白衣人抓去！<NL><NL>“孽障！安敢染指天威！”<NL>白衣之人一声清喝，声震九霄，<NL>身后涌出千万道金丝，铺天盖地缠向妖魔八条巨臂，<NL>妖魔被困，怒啸震天，竟生生挣出一臂，狂舞横扫，直取白衣人面门！

12444859-3f97-4244-b54e-cf9db825b4b3/Eve.en: At this critical moment,<NL>Nüwa's Pentachrome Stones shot forth from her sleeve, transforming into five towering mountains to crash the demon.<NL>Colossal as they were, they were still unable to subdue a demon ? tall.<NL><NL>Sensing this, Nüwa poured all her spiritual Qi into the stones.<NL>Other deities and Buddhas followed suit, channeling their power into them as well.<NL>In the blink of an eye, the five mountains toppled and came crashing down upon the demon like collapsing heavens.<NL>Bound by golden threads and buried by the five mountains, the demon was unable to break free!
12444859-3f97-4244-b54e-cf9db825b4b3/Eve.cn: 便在这千钧一发之际，<NL>女娲袖中五色彩石倏然飞出，化作五座巨山，向妖魔而去，<NL>然而五山虽巨，却何能压得住万丈妖魔，<NL><NL>女娲一念及此，<NL>当即将周身灵气尽数倾注于五色彩石，<NL>诸天神佛见状，亦纷纷效仿，各将法力汇入其间，<NL>眨眼之间，但见五山势如天倾，轰然压住妖魔，<NL>金丝缠身，五山压顶，妖魔一时竟挣脱不得！

33146d3c-1042-4188-b6c0-9660b1c48519/Eve.en: "Demon, face your doom!" <NL><NL>Fuxi he closed his eyes.<NL>Spiritual Qi surged out from his body, and coalesced into a beam of light that ripped through space.<NL>It dispersed the black mist in its path, while blood-ash was driven backward. And finally it struck into the demon's heart.<NL>Letting out piercing wails as black blood splattered across the earth, the demon collapsed, lying prostrate and unable to rise again...
33146d3c-1042-4188-b6c0-9660b1c48519/Eve.cn: “妖魔！伏诛！”<NL><NL>伏羲微微阖目，<NL>体内灵气如洪流决堤，凝聚成一道刺目的光柱，破空而去，<NL>所过之处，黑雾溃散，血灰倒卷，最终刺入妖魔心窍，<NL>耳闻妖魔凄厉哀嚎，嘶声狂啸，眼见魔血迸溅，洒向大地，妖魔就此匍匐不起……

33146d3c-1042-4188-b6c0-9660b1c48519/Opt.en: (Has this formidable demon truly been slain at last?)
33146d3c-1042-4188-b6c0-9660b1c48519/Opt.ru: (Действительно ли этот грозный демон наконец-то убит?)

c2206b47-5d8c-4e25-bf5a-3dab2653b700/Eve.en:
Yet how could this primordial demon accept its doom so easily? <NL><NL>Its blood, scattered across the earth, slowly flowed back into its body.<NL>The demon hurled its eight arms, tearing at the golden threads that bound it and heaving up the mountains that suppressed it, swallowing them all into its maw.<NL>In an instant, black mist erupted skyward, and its colossal form swelled several times over...<NL><NL>"I...cannot be slain...or eradicated...
How could I possibly be defeated... by you lesser beings..."
c2206b47-5d8c-4e25-bf5a-3dab2653b700/Eve.cn: 然而，万古妖魔，岂甘伏诛？<NL><NL>只见遍洒大地的魔血倒流而回，缓缓涌入妖魔体内，<NL>妖魔舞动八臂，拽起缠身的金丝，抬起压身的巨石，一并吞入腹中，<NL>顷刻之间，黑雾冲天而起，妖魔身形大涨数倍……<NL><NL>“本座……杀之不死……灭之不去……<NL>岂会……败于……尔等蚊蝇之手……”

4847ae5c-6cb2-4b5f-9791-76b8611feee1/Eve.en: As the golden threads were swallowed by the demon,<NL>the man in white suffered from the backlash.He casually wiped away the blood trickling from the corner of his lips, smiling coldly rather than showing any trace of anger,<NL>"In the vast cosmos, even immortals are but dust. How much more so for you vile being?<NL>Then let this world be destroyed. I would see how you can possibly survive." <NL><NL>The demon broke free at last and burst into maniacal laughter.<NL>All its eight arms shot outward to claw once more at the heavens.<NL><NL>As a corner of the firmament shattered, black ash rained down like a storm.<NL>The remaining celestial deities and Buddhas surged forward to fight it again.<NL>The man in white looked grim, unleashing countless golden threads that poured down like a waterfall.<NL>Instead of striking the demon, they spread across the sky in all directions and wove into a celestial prison that came crashing down upon it.
4847ae5c-6cb2-4b5f-9791-76b8611feee1/Eve.cn: 金丝尽没妖魔巨口，<NL>白衣之人受其反噬，嘴角沁出血迹，他随手拭去，不怒反笑：<NL>“宇宙乾坤，神仙之外，万物如尘，何况尔等这般污秽不堪之物，<NL>且毁去这方天地，看尔何能不死！不灭！”<NL><NL>终于妖魔脱困，仰天狂笑，<NL>八臂齐展，又向天穹攫去，<NL><NL>穹顶一角应声崩裂，黑灰如雨，纷纷洒落，<NL>余下的诸天神佛见状，又再齐齐迎战而上，<NL>白衣之人神情一凛，无数金丝如瀑垂落，<NL>然那金丝却不向妖魔而去，反在天穹八方交织缠绕，结成一座八方囚笼，轰然落下！

c0d0c851-645b-4702-922f-352e360320fa/Eve.en: The man in white tightened his grip, and the golden threads spanning the heavens thrummed under the strain.<NL>As heaven and earth trembled and the world seemed on the verge of collapse. A gigantic hand suddenly emerged from the clouds. The five fingers, each as massive as a mountain peak, closed around the golden threads and held them fast.<NL>Lowering his dragon-horned head, Fuxi regarded him with serene eyes and spoke in a low voice,<NL><NL>"Even if heaven and earth were overturned, the demon might not be slain."
c0d0c851-645b-4702-922f-352e360320fa/Eve.cn: 白衣人指节微紧，八方金丝铮铮作响，<NL>眼见天地动荡、乾坤将倾，<NL>忽然，一只巨大的手自云间探出，五指如峰，定住金丝，<NL>伏羲龙角低垂，目光沉静，低声说道：<NL><NL>“倾覆天地乾坤，妖魔未必伏诛……”

217605cb-f4c2-4551-86b2-c18bdf22b14e/Eve.en: "Since the separation of heaven and earth, this world has nurtured and sheltered all living things.<NL>Every life matters, no matter which realm it inhabits.<NL>How can you destroy this entire world and everyone in it, even if it means sacrificing your own life to kill the demon?"<NL>A cluster of crimson fire slowly rose from Fuxi's chest, lighting up the endless night.<NL>He looked down upon it in solemn silence, then softly intoned,<NL><NL>"Pangu split heaven and earth, settling all things into their proper places.<NL>The Desire for Nothing is the purest thing in existence. It might be enough to destroy the demon... But...<NL>it is savage. If handled poorly, it will burn this world to ashes."
217605cb-f4c2-4551-86b2-c18bdf22b14e/Eve.cn: “天地开辟，覆载群生，<NL>万方生灵，本来无别，<NL>纵然身死道消，何能轻弃一方生灵……”<NL>一团赤焰自伏羲怀中徐徐浮现，照破无尽长夜，<NL>伏羲垂眸凝视，缓缓开口：<NL><NL>“盘古开天辟地，一物不动不移，悬于天地之间，<NL>无欲无念，是为最纯粹之物，或可除灭魔祟，只是……<NL>此物凶威莫测，稍有不慎，便将焚尽世间……”

7bde2882-53fe-44cb-80ff-c3ccf2d24104/Eve.en: "Haha-haha!<NL>What foolishness made you think a foreign power could shackle me?" <NL>The demon's twelve eyes blazed with murderous fury as its eight arms thrashed wildly, straining to tear this world asunder.<NL>Yet the very instant they breached the divine flame, a violent black fire erupted. Demonic qi swirled out from its limbs as its dark blood gushed forth. <NL><NL>"What is this? It can actually hurt me?" <NL>The demon roared in shock, its twelve eyes zeroing in on Fuxi. Its astonishment quickly flared into anger, then twisted into maniacal laughter.<NL>"Fuxi! You already exhausted yourself in the last battle. How much longer can you hold on? <NL>Let us find out which happens first, you purging my flesh, or me swallowing the whole world!"
7bde2882-53fe-44cb-80ff-c3ccf2d24104/Eve.cn: “哈哈哈哈哈——<NL>区区化外之境，也妄想困住本座？！”<NL>妖魔十二只怪目凶光毕露，八臂狂舞，欲要撕裂此间天地，<NL>谁知方一触及神火，登时黑焰升腾，臂上魔气四溢，魔血汩汩而出！<NL><NL>“这是何物……竟能伤得了本座？！”<NL>妖魔惊啸，十二怪目死死盯着伏羲，旋即，却是由惊转怒，由怒转喜：<NL>“伏羲！适才一战，尔已是神力将尽，尚能撑得几时？<NL>且看看是你先炼化本座，还是本座吞尽天地！”

7bde2882-53fe-44cb-80ff-c3ccf2d24104/Opt.en: (Though the divine flame could wound the fiend... Fuxi's divine power was nigh exhausted...)
7bde2882-53fe-44cb-80ff-c3ccf2d24104/Opt.cn: （此神火虽能伤得了那妖魔……然伏羲神力将近……）
7bde2882-53fe-44cb-80ff-c3ccf2d24104/Opt.ru: (Хотя божественное пламя могло бы и Раны нанести дьяволу... Божественная сила Фуси была почти исчерпана...)

9be7adf6-6d58-4531-b724-dc515d69f248/Eve.en: Fuxi closed his eyes, his face devoid of fear.<NL>Forming a hand seal, eight trigram symbols flew out one by one from behind his back.<NL>From each trigram, a beam of spiritual light shot forth like a bolt of cascading silk, weaving and crisscrossing <NL>into a colossal Eight Trigrams Formation that sealed the demon in place!
9be7adf6-6d58-4531-b724-dc515d69f248/Eve.cn: 伏羲闭目，无有惧色，<NL>掐诀结印，八道卦象一一自身后飞出，<NL>每一卦象之中，各自射出一道灵光，光如匹练，纵横交织，<NL>化作一座巨大的八卦巨阵，将那妖魔镇于此地！

b2c9437d-ba89-47d1-a2e6-c64bb9f8b2f0/Eve.en: With a furious roar, the demon swelled by another thousand zhang.<NL>It swung its eight arms, each as monolithic as a mountain ridge,smashing into the grand formation.<NL>At the deafening impact, two of the trigrams shattered instantly, and fissures webbed across the barrier.<NL>Suffering the severe backlash, Fuxi let out a muffled groan as a trickle of fresh blood leaked from the corner of his mouth, dripping onto the earth.
b2c9437d-ba89-47d1-a2e6-c64bb9f8b2f0/Eve.cn: 妖魔一声怒喝，身形又涨千丈，<NL>八臂横扫，撞向巨阵，臂若山峦，与光相击，<NL>但闻一声震响，两道卦象应声崩碎，阵壁瞬时现出几道裂痕,<NL>伏羲受其反噬，一声闷哼，嘴角沁出一缕鲜血，滴落在地……

a9c14503-e5b9-4bd3-a03e-778f3c40acd3/Eve.en: "Grand Numbers converge into Unity. The Fire governs. The Water revolves. <NL>Defy the laws. Mend the broken. Transform Heavens and Earth. <NL>Seal!" <NL><NL>Fuxi traced an unseen sigil in the air with two fingers and gave a low cry that carried supreme majesty.<NL>In an instant, every fissure in the formation mended completely. The two shattered trigrams coalesced once more, returning to their pristine state.<NL>The eight divine lights fell into their respective domains, weaving above and below, forcing the demon's ten-thousand-zhang frame down into the formation, inch by inch.<NL>As the divine flames coiled upward, the demon shrieked unceasingly, <NL><NL>"Fuxi! Fuxi! I shall deny you a place in reincarnation and obliterate your very soul!"
a9c14503-e5b9-4bd3-a03e-778f3c40acd3/Eve.cn: “九九合一，离斡坎旋。<NL>逆添顺补，变幻坤乾。<NL>镇！”<NL><NL>伏羲双指虚画，一声低喝，竟含无上神威，<NL>霎时，阵网裂隙尽数弥合，那两道崩碎的卦象重聚成形，复位如初，<NL>八道神光逐一落位，上下交错，竟将妖魔万丈之躯，一寸寸强压回阵网之中，<NL>神火缠绕而上，妖魔厉啸不绝：<NL><NL>“伏羲！伏羲！本座要尔等轮回无处，神魂俱灭！”

9a3ef904-24d0-466a-ae5b-7d26cfafa585/Eve.en: After an unmeasured passage of time,<NL>the demon's shrieks gradually subsided. However, a few wisps of dark aura began to seep through the glowing mesh of the formation.<NL>Fuxi's face darkened instantly. Before he could react, the dark aura erupted like a tidal wave, smothering half of the sky-spanning divine flames.<NL>Eight arms, cloaked in dark mist and the choking embers of the divine fire, tore through the shattered net, closing in on Fuxi from all sides.<NL>Amidst the dying brilliance of the flames, the demon laughed maniacally,<NL><NL>"Hahaha! A mere drop of your spent blood can summon such godlike might? <NL>T Today, I shall feast upon your flesh first, then swallow the heavens and the earth whole!" Hearing this, <NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> was struck with horror, and when looking back to where Fuxi had stood earlier, found that<NL>the drop of fresh blood was gone, stealthily devoured by it at some unknown moment...
9a3ef904-24d0-466a-ae5b-7d26cfafa585/Eve.cn: 不知过了多久，<NL>妖魔啸声渐渐沉寂，几缕黑气自阵网渗出，<NL>伏羲登时面色一沉，不及反应，那黑气已如潮涌出，竟而将漫天神火压下半分，<NL>八只裹挟着神火残烬与黑气的手臂穿透阵网，朝伏羲合围而来，<NL>神火明灭之间，妖魔狂笑不止：<NL><NL>“哈哈哈——一滴伏羲残血，竟也有此等神威！<NL>本座今日便先食尔血肉，再吞尽天地！”<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />闻言一惊，再看此前伏羲所立之处，<NL>一滴鲜血，果然不见，竟是不知何时被妖魔吞吃……

9a3ef904-24d0-466a-ae5b-7d26cfafa585/Opt.en: (The demon's power surges... How will Fuxi respond?)

96bed506-0ca4-416f-a4f9-52f3c090115f/Eve.en: Fuxi soared into the air,<NL>but the demon abruptly grew another thousand zhang. With nowhere to evade, a colossal palm pierced straight through Fuxi's arm.<NL>Blood splattered into the divine fire, sizzling loudly as it vaporized into white smoke.<NL><NL>"My flesh and blood were born of heaven and earth, and to heaven and earth they shall return..."<NL>Floating in the air, Fuxi moved his fingers quickly to weave hand seals.<NL>His divine power bled away without cease, and his godly form gradually became translucent.<NL>Beneath his feet, a torrent of golden light suddenly poured down upon the demon.<NL>He was dispersing his divine soul to form an ultimate formation that would seal it forever. <NL><NL>"Light is eclipsed. The universe is in disorder.<NL>Calamity-fire burns the heavens. The Chiliocosm lays devastated.<NL>We must not let the demon escape, even if it costs us our lives!"
96bed506-0ca4-416f-a4f9-52f3c090115f/Eve.cn: 伏羲飞身而起，<NL>然而妖魔骤长千丈，伏羲避无可避，一只巨掌径直穿透臂膀，<NL>鲜血飞溅，落入神火，嗤嗤作响，化作白烟，<NL><NL>“吾之血肉，生于天地，自当归于天地……”<NL>伏羲凌空而立，五指如轮，掐诀结印，<NL>但见其神力不断散逸，神躯渐而透明，<NL>足下万道金光倏然蔓延，铺天盖地向那妖魔落去，<NL>伏羲竟然散去神元，化作大阵，要将那妖魔彻底镇压！<NL><NL>“明夷蒙晦，乾坤失序，<NL>劫火焚天，大千俱坏，<NL>吾等生死，不足道哉……只是，绝不能放走了妖魔！”

96bed506-0ca4-416f-a4f9-52f3c090115f/Opt.en: (We must not let the demon escape, even if it costs us our lives!)
96bed506-0ca4-416f-a4f9-52f3c090115f/Opt.cn: （吾等生死，不足道哉……只是，绝不能放走了妖魔！）
96bed506-0ca4-416f-a4f9-52f3c090115f/Opt.ru: (Мы не должны позволить демону сбежать, даже если это будет стоить нам жизни!)

2b6342ed-db01-486f-b2e5-f2a173b5cd18/Eve.en: Spiritual light scattered in all directions.<NL>The eight trigrams trembled violently and were shattered one by one by the demon.<NL>The demon roared at the heavens, stretching all eight arms to break free from the formation.<NL>Yet, at this critical moment, the golden formation slammed down! <NL><NL>Though trapped within, the demon's ferocious malice did not dwindle at all. It laughed wildly, its voice rattling heaven and earth, <NL>"Fuxi... What do you take me for? <NL>I devour the heavens and feast upon the earth! <NL>I slaughter the deities! <NL>I obliterate the Buddhas! <NL>I was born from the heart's blood of Pangu! <NL>I was nurtured before the Primordial Chaos ever split! <NL>I am... the Greatest Demon of All!" <NL><NL>The demon thrust its eight arms upward,<NL>lifting the grand formation by an inch.<NL>Then, with a shattering stomp of its foot, the formation was heaved a whole zhang higher!
2b6342ed-db01-486f-b2e5-f2a173b5cd18/Eve.cn: 灵光四散，<NL>八道卦象齐齐震颤，竟被妖魔一一击碎，<NL>妖魔仰天长啸，八臂齐伸，将要破阵而出，<NL>便在此际，那金光大阵，轰然落下！<NL><NL>然那妖魔被困其中，凶威仍是不减，仰天狂笑，震彻天地：<NL>“伏羲……你道本座……是为何物！<NL>本座吞得天，食得地！<NL>本座杀得通天神！<NL>灭得过去未来佛！<NL>本座生自盘古心头血！<NL>本座长在混沌未开时！<NL>本座……是为万古第一妖魔！”<NL><NL>妖魔八臂上举，<NL>大阵竟被抬起一寸，<NL>妖魔猛地踏足，大阵竟又被抬高一丈！

2b6342ed-db01-486f-b2e5-f2a173b5cd18/Opt.en: No... We can't let the demon escape!
2b6342ed-db01-486f-b2e5-f2a173b5cd18/Opt.ru: Нет... Мы не можем позволить демону сбежать!

2614f769-6336-49f0-9a07-aa229308da2f/Eve.en: At the thought of it, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s mind went blank amidst a sudden boom! <NL>Suddenly, a strange power manifested, transforming from a formless thought into a tangible body.<NL>Immediately following, a massive surge of spiritual energy poured into the whole body.<NL>It felt as though it had lain dormant through endless aeons, waiting only for this precise moment to return to <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s body, to be wielded to slay the demon!
2614f769-6336-49f0-9a07-aa229308da2f/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />一念至此，突然脑中一阵轰鸣！<NL>忽地生出一股诡力，竟自无形之念，渐而化成有形之躯，<NL>紧接着，一道巨大的灵力不断涌向四肢百骸、五脏六腑，<NL>仿佛静伏无尽岁月，只待此时此刻，重归<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />之身，执以斩妖诛魔！

401276a8-1473-4042-966d-fa95b775738c/Eve.en: Treading upon the divine fire as if walking on golden lotuses<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> stepped behind Fuxi and gently raised a palm against his back.<NL>Fuxi's heart jolted. He felt a primordial power never seen before surge into him from behind.<NL>It was not as majesty as divine power, and nor was it pure as divine fire.<NL>Yet, it was inexhaustible, and indestructible.<NL>Against such a force, how could any deity or demon possibly stand a chance? <NL><NL>This power converged into the grand formation, like overwhelming mountains, or a tightening heavenly net, <NL>crushing heavily upon the demon's ten-thousand-zhang frame!
401276a8-1473-4042-966d-fa95b775738c/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />足踏神火，如履金莲，<NL>行至伏羲身后，轻轻抬起手掌，<NL>伏羲心头一震，但觉一股亘古未有的力量从背后涌来，<NL>无神力之威严，无神火之纯粹，<NL>然而绵长无尽、坚不可摧，<NL>纵使神魔，岂敢争锋？<NL><NL>此力汇聚大阵，登如山岳倾压，又如天网收拢，<NL>重重压上妖魔万丈身躯！

bba1d2c7-ef9a-42e3-9811-fea4cef671af/Eve.en:
"Fuxi! <NL>No... No! How could Fuxi possess such power? <NL>Who is it? Who is it!" Who dares to confine me?" <NL><NL>Trapped in the formation, the demon thrashed its eight arms wildly, and kept shrieking.<NL>Yet no matter how it struggled, the grand formation remained intact.<NL>Amidst the churning crimson flames and billowing heatwaves, the demon's corrupt blood evaporated into rolling black smoke.<NL>Its twelve monstrous eyes turned from blood-red to a lifeless white, one by one. Its ten-thousand-zhang body was incinerated inch by inch in the divine fire! <NL><NL>"I was born from... the heart's blood of Pangu...<NL>I was nurtured... before the Primordial Chaos ever split
<NL>I am immortal... imperishable...<NL>Wait until I... reconvene my demonic soul... I will tear this world asunder, overturn the universe...<NL>I'll obliterate your bodies and souls!"
bba1d2c7-ef9a-42e3-9811-fea4cef671af/Eve.cn: “伏羲！<NL>不……不……伏羲安能有此神通！<NL>是谁！是谁！是谁困住本座？！”<NL><NL>妖魔被困大阵，八臂狂舞，厉啸不绝，<NL>然而任其如何挣扎，大阵仍是纹丝不动，<NL>赤焰翻涌，热浪蒸腾之间，但见妖魔魔血化作滚滚黑烟，<NL>十二只怪目一一由赤转白，万丈巨躯在那神火之中寸寸焚尽、节节崩毁！<NL><NL>“本座生自……盘古心头血……<NL>本座长在……混沌未开时……<NL>本座不死……不灭……<NL>待本座……重聚魔元，定要……撕碎这天地，掀翻这乾坤，<NL>定将尔等形！神！俱！灭！”

d46778bd-5308-42e1-b7c0-cfd75b74603f/Eve.en: Finally, deep within the divine fire, only a wisp of the demon's soul remained struggling in vain! <NL>The primordial demon was, at long last, annihilated!
d46778bd-5308-42e1-b7c0-cfd75b74603f/Eve.cn: 终于，<NL>神火深处，唯余一缕妖魔元神，兀自挣扎！<NL>万古妖魔，至此伏诛！
d46778bd-5308-42e1-b7c0-cfd75b74603f/Eve.ru: Наконец, глубоко внутри божественного огня осталась лишь частичка души демона, тщетно борющаяся! <NL>Изначальный демон был, наконец, уничтожен!

e78ad2dd-c62e-4a2e-8926-ca64115d3ea2/Eve.en: Yet,<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> was now running on nothing but sheer will. But it's on the verge of fading away...
e78ad2dd-c62e-4a2e-8926-ca64115d3ea2/Eve.cn: 然而，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />一点心念，竭力一战，至此，已是将尽之时……
e78ad2dd-c62e-4a2e-8926-ca64115d3ea2/Eve.ru: Пока что,<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> теперь он не полагался ни на что, кроме чистой воли. Но это на грани исчезновения...

8542337d-4db3-4f6c-8854-4c23704f3aa0/Eve.en: "All creation beneath the heavens... lives because of you..."<NL><NL>As his divine soul dissolved, Fuxi forced his hands forward, his ten fingers rising like mountains, to gently hold <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> as one would cradle a dying ember of starlight. <NL>"I know... you... harbor the aura of Xiangshu... You are not a spirit born of this world... <NL>Yet I know not... from whence you came..."
8542337d-4db3-4f6c-8854-4c23704f3aa0/Eve.cn: “天地万物，得尔相救……”<NL><NL>伏羲神元将散，勉力伸出双掌，十指如峰，<NL>将<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />轻轻捧起，拢在掌心，如托一点将熄的星火：<NL>“吾知……尔……身藏相枢气息……并非此世之灵……<NL>然不知……尔自何方而来……”

8542337d-4db3-4f6c-8854-4c23704f3aa0/Opt.en: I came from the mortal realm. I am but a common man... named Taiwu...
8542337d-4db3-4f6c-8854-4c23704f3aa0/Opt.cn: 我自人间而来，是为凡人……名唤太吾……
8542337d-4db3-4f6c-8854-4c23704f3aa0/Opt.ru: Я пришел из царства смертных. Я всего лишь обычный человек... по имени Тайу...

4318c9f1-e2cc-4e45-a721-840733c94e64/Eve.en: "Taiwu... Taiwu... I am perishing... May this remnant of my power... guard you back to the mortal realm..."<NL><NL>Fuxi lowered his dragon-horned head.<NL>Between his palms, a few remaining wisps of divine power twined around <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s body. <NL>In a daze, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> felt a pair of colossal hands hold fast to the fading consciousness, <NL>Then, it was as if the mind plummeted into an endless primordial chaos, and all sensation slipped away...
4318c9f1-e2cc-4e45-a721-840733c94e64/Eve.cn: “太吾……太吾……吾将身死道消……<NL>愿此残存之力，护尔归去人间……”<NL><NL>伏羲龙角低垂，<NL>双掌之间化出几缕残存神力，萦绕<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />周身，<NL>恍惚之间，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />只觉一双巨掌拢住自己几欲散去的心念，<NL>而后，意识便即坠入无边混沌，彻底失去了知觉……

d50951ab-5060-4d8c-83ba-dc82302910b8/Eve.en: In the epoch that followed,<NL>the sun and moon cast their light anew, and all creation was reborn...<NL>Heaven and earth wept in shared grief at the fall of Fuxi.....<NL>As his soul scattered into nothingness, his lingering will <NL>entrusted the demon's final shard, along with his own unfulfilled wishes, to Nuwa.
d50951ab-5060-4d8c-83ba-dc82302910b8/Eve.cn: 在这之后，<NL>日月垂光，万物重生……<NL>伏羲神陨，天地同悲……<NL>其神元散尽之际，唯余一点残念，<NL>将那妖魔一缕魔元与心中未尽之愿，一并托付女娲……

999f4425-68a1-4779-b347-0122507ea12a/Eve.en: The moment <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> drew near the "Demonic Blood of Xiangshu", a violent tide of raw desires engulfed th mind. <NL>Despite desperate attempts to suppress it, endless whispers rasped in the ears, triggering a splitting headache that drove them to the brink of collapse.<NL><NL>Right then, a piercing, icy current from within <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s bosom permeated the bones. <NL>Mind clearing slightly, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> reached into chest...
999f4425-68a1-4779-b347-0122507ea12a/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />堪堪行至“相枢魔血”近前，顿觉欲念如潮，汹涌而至，<NL>饶是竭力遏制，耳畔仍有无数低语之声，搅得头疼欲裂，几欲晕去，<NL><NL>便在这时，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />怀中一股阴寒之气直透百骸，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />神智稍清，探手入怀……

24f456d4-0ce2-4322-8a95-55475d43652a/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> drew forth the Fuyu Hilt, <NL>but found a ghostly thread of black flame flickering on the very edge of extinction...
24f456d4-0ce2-4322-8a95-55475d43652a/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />取出「伏虞剑柄」，<NL>却见其上冒出一缕幽幽黑焰，聚散不定，将灭未灭……
24f456d4-0ce2-4322-8a95-55475d43652a/Eve.ru: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> вытащил Рукоять Фую, <NL>но обнаружил призрачную нить черного пламени, мерцающую на самой грани угасания...

24f456d4-0ce2-4322-8a95-55475d43652a/Opt.en: What is this black flame? Why have I never seen it before...
24f456d4-0ce2-4322-8a95-55475d43652a/Opt.cn: 这缕黑焰，却是何物，何以此前从未得见……
24f456d4-0ce2-4322-8a95-55475d43652a/Opt.ru: Что это за черное пламя? Почему я никогда не видел этого раньше?..

d8cdad9d-6e5d-406b-b4c9-1c2ad3060e4d/Eve.en: Suddenly, that tiny wisp of black flame broke free from the sword hilt and lunged straight toward the Demonic Blood.<NL>Wherever it passed, it swept like a wildfire, devouring the Demonic Blood to the very last drop in a mere breath.<NL>Yet, even after consuming the blood, the black flame seemed insatiable. It coiled upward, wrapping around <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s arms in an unyielding grip.
d8cdad9d-6e5d-406b-b4c9-1c2ad3060e4d/Eve.cn: 忽而那一缕小小黑焰，破剑而出，向那“魔血”直扑而去，<NL>所过之处，如火燎原，须臾之间，便将“魔血”吞吃殆尽，<NL>然那黑焰吞吃“魔血”之后，竟似犹未餍足，翻卷而上，缠上<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />双臂，盘旋不去……

ae55320d-b076-43d9-b45e-9934bf7cccf2/Eve.en: Reaching out to touch the black flame, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> was met with a bone-eroding, soul-ravaging chill.<NL>The sheer shock of the agony instantly snapped the mind back to stark clarity.
ae55320d-b076-43d9-b45e-9934bf7cccf2/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />伸手触碰黑焰，但觉冷意蚀骨，销魂夺魄，<NL>登时神思陡清，猛然醒转……
ae55320d-b076-43d9-b45e-9934bf7cccf2/Eve.ru: Протягиваю руку, чтобы коснуться черного пламени, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> был встречен пронизывающим до костей, опустошающим душу холодом.<NL>Явный шок от агонии мгновенно вернул разуму абсолютную ясность.

ae55320d-b076-43d9-b45e-9934bf7cccf2/Opt.en: (Shaken and bewildered. Examine the Fuyu Hilt...)
ae55320d-b076-43d9-b45e-9934bf7cccf2/Opt.ru: (Потрясенный и сбитый с толку. Осмотрите Рукоять Фую...)

9fc0271f-2d0c-488a-a3ee-64d3a9133ccf/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> looked up and saw the treasury wide open where the wooden chests were laid bare.<NL>Gold, silver, pearls, and jade gleamed with radiant brilliance, while glaze cups and emerald vases mirrored each other's splendor.<NL>Inside several of the chests lay precious swords, their scabbards inlaid with priceless orbs...<NL><NL>In brocade boxes rested night-glowing pearls, rounded and luminous as the moon. <NL>In jade cases lay rare herbs and exotic fragrant flora.<NL>These countless treasures were dazzling enough to ignite the greed of any mortal soul...
9fc0271f-2d0c-488a-a3ee-64d3a9133ccf/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />抬眼望去，只见府库大开、木箱敞露，<NL>其间金银珠玉，流光溢彩，更有琉璃玉盏、翡翠宝瓶……交相辉映，<NL>数口木箱之中，更有数柄宝剑，剑鞘嵌珠，绝非凡品……<NL><NL>另见锦盒装盛夜明之珠，圆润如月；<NL>玉匣之内放置奇珍异草，异香扑鼻，<NL>琳琅满目，不可胜数，端的令人目眩神摇，动人心魄……

9fc0271f-2d0c-488a-a3ee-64d3a9133ccf/Opt.cn: （眼前所见，耳中所闻，是真是幻……）

55a8fde3-f24b-4a06-a414-089a2eec48d6/Eve.en: Before <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> could process this, drifting whispers reached the ears.<NL>A few nearby guards were chattering smugly:<NL><NL>"Tsk, look at this! Mountains of treasure!
